m200200.――コホン。失礼いたしました。\n貴殿のお部屋の作りが、私が元いた地のそれとは\: —Ahem. My apologies. The layout of your quarters is so different from what I'm used to that I couldn't help but stare.
m200200.……え、王子殿も協力してくださると？\nしかし、私たちはもう十分なお心づくしを…: …What, Prince, you'll help as well? We've already done everything we can…
m200200.……ひょっとすると、ご主人様が\n天の世界から我らの世界へいらした時も、\n今の: …Perhaps when your master first stepped from the heavens into our world, he felt just as bewildered as I do now.
m200200.……まったく。\nですが、受けた恩義に報いぬようでは、\n確かに孫呉末代の恥とも: ...Good grief. Still, to ignore the debt we've received would be a disgrace to the last generation of Sun Wu.
m200200.……わかりました。\nでは、ご厚意に甘えるとしましょう。\n王子殿、今後とも宜し: ...I understand. Then I'll take you up on your kindness. Prince, I look forward to working with you from now on.
m200200.……失礼。本題に戻りましょう。\n私は今後、この世界に来ているかもしれない者たち: …Excuse me. Back to the matter at hand. I intend to search for and rescue anyone else who may have been drawn to this world.
m200200.……王子、折り入って頼みがあるんだが、\n帰る前に貴軍に所属する強者たちと\n一: Prince, I have a favor to ask. Before we depart, could we face off against some of the strong warriors in your ranks?
m200200.……私からも補足させて頂きます。\n関羽さんたちをこの世界に招いたのは、過去にも: …Let me add something, too. I think the “gate to another world” that brought you and Kan'u here is the same one we've seen before in the past.
m200200.あらためまして、王子殿。\n先の戦で救って頂いたのみならず、私とご主人様を\n御: Allow me to thank you again, Prince. Not only did you rescue us in the last battle, but you also gave my master and me shelter in your castle.
m200200.か、勝手に話を進めないでください！\n第一、私の意思はどうなるのですか？: D-Don't jump ahead with the story! First, what about my own wishes?
m200200.ここが王子殿の執務室か……。\n我が国の王侯のそれとはずいぶん趣が異なるのだな。: So this is Prince's office… It looks nothing like the chambers of our own nobles back home.
m200200.そして、そのような無礼を働いた私たちを\nこうして客として扱っていただいているこ: And we are deeply grateful that you still treat us as guests despite our rudeness.
m200200.その『異界の門』の件ですが、\nすでに複数の『門』が各地に出現していることが\n: As for that gate, reports from the Sentinels show that multiple gates have already appeared across the land.
m200200.その『門』が、先の戦いにおいて\n魔王軍の部隊を指揮していた『異界召喚士』なる者: If those gates were summoned by the “Otherworld Summoner” who commanded the Demon King's forces in the recent battle…
m200200.ですが、やはり長居をしては恐縮ですし、\n既に関羽たちも元の世界へ戻ったと伺いま: Still, we feel it's rude to overstay our welcome, and I've heard Kan'u and the others have already returned to their world, so once my mother and I are ready, we'll take our leave...
m200200.というわけだ。\n王子、ひとつ宜しく頼むぞ。: So that's that. Prince, I have one request.
m200200.にわかには信じがたい話ですが、\n文化の違いや、妖術で治療を施して頂いたことなど: It's a hard thing to believe at first, but considering the cultural differences and the magical healing we received, it does make sense.
m200200.まあ聞け蓮華。\n王子の軍にまだまだ強い奴らがいることは\nお前も気づいておった: Listen, Renka. You've noticed there are still plenty of powerful fighters in the Prince's army, haven't you?
m200200.もし、私やご主人様と同様の境遇の者がいるとすれば、\nきっと見知らぬこの世界で困: If there are others sharing our fate, they're probably struggling in this unfamiliar realm. I could never abandon them.
m200200.ククク……異郷の地の猛者たちと戦える機会など、\n今を逃したら二度とないかもしれ: Heh... A chance to battle the heroes of a foreign land might never come again if we miss it now.
m200200.ククッ……そう警戒するな。\n我らは既に貴殿の敵ではないのだからな。: Heh heh... No need to be so wary. We're no longer your enemies.
m200200.代わりと言ってはなんだが、\n元の世界で為すべきことが一段落したら、\nこの仲謀: In exchange, once your business in the original world is settled, I promise to lend my allies' strength to your cause.
m200200.先ほどアンナ殿から伺いました。\nこの世界は私たちが元々いた世界とは\n全く異な: Earlier, Lady Anna told me that this world is likely completely different from the one we came from.
m200200.揚州一の美女とその娘を侍らせられるのだ。\nククッ、悪い話ではあるまい？: You'll have the most beautiful woman of Yangzhou and her daughter at your side. Heh, not a bad deal, right?
m200200.本来ならばすぐにでも御恩に報いたいところ。\n……ですが、恐縮ながら、\n事態は: I'd repay your kindness at once, but I'm afraid the situation is far more urgent than that.
m200200.此度の恩義、いずれ必ず報いに参りましょう。\n孫呉の王の血族として、斯くの如く誓: I will repay this kindness someday. As blood of the Sun Wu king, I swear it here.
m200200.此度は貴殿に詫びを入れに来たのだ。\n王子殿……事情があってのこととはいえ、\n: I've come to apologize. Prince... despite the circumstances, I'm truly sorry we targeted your life.
m200200.特に、別室で休ませて頂いているご主人様には\n手厚く治療まで施して頂きまして……: Especially my master, who's been staying in the separate room—your care and even the treatment you provided… I can't find the words to express my gratitude.
m200200.私の他にも、この世界に召喚された者たちが\n存在する可能性が高い、ということにな: That means there are likely many others who, like me, have been summoned to this world.
m200200.関羽さん、困った時はお互い様ですよ。\nそれに王子は関羽さんと同じで\n困ってい: Kan'u, we help each other when we're in trouble. And just like you, the Prince can't stand by without helping those in need.

m200567.……よかったですよね、祝祭が中止にならなくて。: …It's a relief the festival isn't being cancelled, right?
m200567.──が、民間人の安全が最優先だ。\n今を以ってスィーテンの目的が不明な以上、\n:
—but civilian safety comes first.
Since we still don't know Sitten's motives, we have to be ready for anything.
m200567.──というわけで、二人には花嫁になってもらいます。: So, the two of you will become brides.
m200567.ああ、あそこは師弟みたいなもんだからな。: Yeah, it's kind of like a master-apprentice thing.
m200567.ああ、本当に酷い目に遭ったぜ。: Yeah, we really got a rough deal.
m200567.あのラウラ様がねぇ……アダマス教の竜聖女様だぜ？: That Laura... she's the Dragon Saint of the Adamas Church, you know?
m200567.ありがとうラウラ、助かったわ。\nそれじゃあ会場に戻りましょうか。: Thanks, Laura. That helped a lot. Shall we head back to the venue?
m200567.いやー、偶然にも帝国の学会に参加していまして―。: Well, I happened to be attending the Empire's academic conference—.
m200567.おや、ニーカさん。帝国に来ていたのですね。: Oh, Nika. You've been in the Empire, huh?
m200567.お祭りも王子も、逃げたりはしませんから……ね？: Neither the festival nor the Prince will run away… okay?
m200567.こうして実物を見て確信しました。\n犯人は災厄の魔女、スィーテンです。:
Seeing it in person confirmed it.
The culprit is the Disaster Witch, Sitten.
m200567.これで心置きなく花嫁になれるというものよ。\n私が王子のハートを射止めるのも時間:
Now I can become a bride without any reservations.
It's only a matter of time before I capture the Prince's heart.
m200567.こんなに綺麗なエメラルドの髪なんですから、\nしっかりお手入れしないともったいな: With hair this gorgeous emerald green, you'd be wasting it if you didn't take good care of it.
m200567.そういうあなたは余裕そうね、ラウラ。\n新参者の私なんて眼中にもないのかしら？:
You seem so confident, Laura.
I wonder if someone like me, a newcomer, is even on your radar?
m200567.それじゃあ、ジューンブライドの祝祭はどうするの？: Then what about the June Bride festival?
m200567.それで、あの植物について何か分かったかしら？: So, did you find out anything about that plant?
m200567.それでもね、私は負ける気なんて一切ないわ。\nだって、一番欲しいものがそこにある: Still, I have no intention of losing. After all, what I want most is right there.
m200567.ったく、とうとう帝国にも現れやがったか。: Good grief, she's finally shown up even in the Empire.
m200567.でも、急にそんなこと言われてもね……。: But it's a bit sudden to ask that...
m200567.まじまじ、信じられないのも分かるけどな。: I get it, it's hard to believe.
m200567.まずは被害状況の把握と、次の出現地点の予測だ。: First, we need to assess the damage and predict the next emergence points.
m200567.まだ十秒も経ってません、落ち着いてくださいね。: It hasn't even been ten seconds, please stay calm.
m200567.みんなの尽力の結果、でしょうね。\n祝祭に参加した民間人の被害はゼロ、\n完全勝:
That's thanks to everyone's hard work.
No civilian casualties at the festival, so calling it a complete victory isn't an exaggeration.
m200567.やるわ。任せてちょうだい。: Consider it done. Leave it to me.
m200567.エレオノーラ様っておっとりしてるけど、\nなぜかラウラ様にだけは異様に厳しいよな: Eleonora seems gentle, but she's oddly harsh only with Laura.
m200567.カルペムさんなら本当にやってのけてしまいそうです。: If it's Carpem-san, I'm pretty sure you'll pull it off.
m200567.ラウラ、これは命令です。いいですね？: Laura, this is an order. Understood?
m200567.三人ともよく戻った。とんだ災難だったようだな。: You three made it back safely. That was quite a disaster, huh?
m200567.人に歴史ありってこった。さっ、仕事に戻んぞ。: Everyone's got a past. Alright, back to work.
m200567.人為的に植え付けられたもの、ということですか？: You mean it was artificially planted?
m200567.勝っても負けても恨みっこなし。\nラウラ、いい勝負にしましょうね？: Win or lose, I'll hold no grudge. Laura, let's make this a good match, okay?
m200567.命に別状はありませんが、治療には時間が必要でしょう。: It's not life-threatening, but recovery will take time.
m200567.問題は、これが自然発生した植物ではないということです。: The problem is, this isn't a naturally occurring plant.
m200567.実を言うと、現在進行形で各地から\n似たような事件の報告が上がっている。: To be honest, reports of similar incidents are coming in from all over right now.
m200567.帝国でもジューンブライドの祝祭の開催が決定しまして。\n初回ということもあり人員: The Empire has decided to hold the June Bride Festival. Since it's the first one, selecting participants has been tough—
m200567.帝国はこれを災厄の魔女によるテロと断定、\n国内全域に寄生植物に対する警戒令を発: The Empire is labeling this as terrorism by the Disaster Witch and issuing a nationwide alert against parasitic plants.
m200567.当時は帝国軍すら手を焼くほどに凶暴だったラウラ様を、\nまだ司祭だった頃のエレオ: They say Eleonora, back when she was still a priestess, reformed Laura, who was so ferocious that even the Imperial army struggled with her.
m200567.時間も人手も足りん。花嫁にもビシバシ働いてもらう。: We're short on time and manpower. The brides will have to pull their weight.
m200567.最後の仕上げの途中です、もう少し待ってくださいね。: I'm still putting the finishing touches on it, just a little longer.
m200567.特別ゲストとして、花婿役に王子をお呼びしています。: We've invited the Prince to serve as the special guest groom.
m200567.異種族融和の架け橋をテーマとして、\n竜人であるお二人が選ばれたわけです。: The theme is a bridge of interspecies harmony, so the two of you, being dragonfolk, were chosen.
m200567.白の帝国は魔女に屈しない、予定通り開催予定だ。: The White Empire won't bow to the witch; the festival will go on as planned.
m200567.私たちが出演するイベントは二つ。\n教会で王子との『模擬結婚式』に──: We have two events to perform: a mock wedding with the Prince at the church—
m200567.私はあなたをライバルだと思っているわ。\nもちろんグラティアも、他のみんなもね。: I see you as a rival. — Gratia, too, and everyone else.
m200567.私は花嫁役を辞退したく思うのですが……。: I would like to decline the bride role...
m200567.終わったら言いますから、それまで動かないで。: I'll let you know when I'm done, so don't move until then.
m200567.謎の寄生植物と聞いてお邪魔させてもらいました。\n王国でも、以前に似たような事件:
I heard about the mysterious parasitic plant, so I dropped by.
There was a similar incident back in the kingdom before—
m200567.通常の寄生植物とは一線を画す存在ですね。\n植物と言うより、魔物の方が近いかもし: It's unlike ordinary parasitic plants. It's more like a monster than a plant.
m200567.（幸せとは何なのかも答えられない私に、\n果たしてそれを願う資格があるのでしょう: (Can someone who can't even answer what happiness is truly wish for it…?)

m200592.――あれ？ あっちに見えるのは……。\nま、ま、魔物の群れ！？:
――Huh? What I see over there is…
A-A-A swarm of monsters!?
m200592.――いったい何が……。\n天竜核の暴走が、収まっていく……？:
—What on earth is...
The Heavenly Dragon Core's rampage is subsiding...?
m200592.――うっひゃー！\nすっごいよ！ 完全未発見の遺跡だー！:
—Whoa!
This is amazing! A completely undiscovered ruin!
m200592.――おや？ 皆さんお揃いで。\n今は天眼ノ国の助力に向かっているのでは……。:
――Oh? You're all here together.
I thought you were off to aid the Heavenly Eye Kingdom…
m200592.――こいつは、人の姿しか取れないドラゴンだ。: —This one is a dragon who can only take human form.
m200592.――さぁ、儀式を始めろ。\nこの場は王子たちが守ってくれる。:
――Now, begin the ritual.
The Princes will defend this place.
m200592.――ただ、竜都の民には謝ることが。\nこの竜都の奥から、\n私に流れ込んでいたも:
――However, I do owe an apology to the people of the Dragon Capital.
From the depths of this Dragon Capital,
I sense a power of the same kind that was flowing into me.
m200592.――っ、足元が……！？\n王子、街が傾いています！:
—! The ground is...!
Prince, the city is tilting!
m200592.――っ。\nなに……？ 誰か、呼んだ……？:
—!
What...? Did someone... call out to me?
m200592.――っ！？ 今、頭上を何かが……！\n王子、戻ってきます！:
――Huh!? Something just…… above us!
Prince, I'm coming back!
m200592.――できましたー。\n少人数でしたら、問題なくあちらへ渡れますー。:
――It's done.
A small group can cross over to the other side without any issues.
m200592.――はー、なるほど。\n急遽想定にない魔界行きが必要になったと。:
――Ha, I see.
So we suddenly need to make an unplanned trip to the Demon Realm.
m200592.――ほう、人の身で、よく届かせた。: —Hm. For a mortal, you struck true.
m200592.――ギルガメッシュ、\nこれ以上、世界を壊させはしない……ッ！！:
—Gilgamesh,
I won't let you destroy the world any further…!!
m200592.――ケルドラ嬢、そなたの方が\n竜ノ国には詳しいと見たが？:
——Miss Kerudra, I see you are
more familiar with the Dragon Country.
m200592.――ラピス！ ラピスー！\n大丈夫か！？ いったい何をしたんだ！？:
――Lapis! Lapis!
Are you all right?! What did you do?!
m200592.――リヴァイアサンから、何か発射された？\nアルレット！ そっちから見える！？:
—Did the Leviathan fire something?
Arlette! Can you see it from your side?!
m200592.――リヴァイアサンの再起動計画。\nそれの契約を結んだのは、太守ではない。\nこ:
—The Leviathan Restart Plan.

The one who signed that contract was not the Governor.

This man offered his own soul.
m200592.――報告！\n王子、敵ドラゴンが外壁を突破した模様！:
—Report!
Prince, it appears the enemy dragons have breached the outer wall!
m200592.――失礼な。予定を繰り上げただけですよ。: How rude. I merely brought the schedule forward.
m200592.――将軍閣下、リヴァイアサンのブレスが、\n正体不明の魔力によって中和されており:
—General, the Leviathan's breath
is being neutralized by an unidentified source of mana.
m200592.――帰ってきた、な。\n今度はこの国を、攻め滅ぼす者として。:
――You're back, aren't you.
This time, as the one who will conquer and destroy this nation.
m200592.――母の首を取るところを、\nその娘に見せることなどできない。\nそして、民にと:
—I cannot let her daughter see
the moment her mother's head is taken.
Nor can I take away the homeland from her people.
m200592.――王剣をここに！\nこれが、私たちの答えよ！！:
――Here, Royal Sword!
This is our answer!!
m200592.――王子、こちらの被害は軽微ですが、\n天眼ノ国の方が、もう保ちません。:
――Prince, our casualties are light,
but the Heavenly Eye Nation can no longer hold.
m200592.――現在、天竜核はモードリオンの手にあります。\nただ、私が橋渡しをすれば、\n:
――Currently, the Dragon Core is in Morion's possession.
However, if I act as a bridge,
it is possible to conclude a contract via Leviathan.
m200592.――行くぞ、シビラ。\n答えを掴み取るときだ。:
—Let's go, Sybilla.
It's time to seize the answer.
m200592.――見せてみよ。\nこの世界で、貴様らが何をできるのか。:
—Show me.
What you are capable of in this world.
m200592.――諸君、１３周年デアル！！\n王子ノ救援要請ニ応エ、\n我らゴブリン軍団、世界:
—Everyone, it's our 13th anniversary!
In response to the Prince's call for aid,
the Goblin Legion has crossed worlds to arrive!
m200592.――馬鹿。大馬鹿。大馬鹿召喚士……！: ――Idiot. Such an idiot. A truly idiotic summoner...!
m200592.――驚きました。\n無理やりどころか、むしろ天竜核の方から、\nふたりの契約を受:
――I'm surprised.
It's not forced at all; in fact, the Dragon Core itself
has accepted the contract between you two.
m200592.――魔神レヴィアタンでしょうか？\nあれはリヴァイアサンの原型となったもので、\:
—and the Demon God Leviathan, perhaps?
That one served as the prototype for the Leviathan,
an individual that aimed to encompass the world itself.
m200592.…………すまない。\n敵である我が国まで救ってくれるとは。:
??? : ...I am sorry.
To save even the nation that is my enemy...
m200592.…………っ！\nリヴァイアサンの中心で、魔力の大規模な乱れが……。:
…………Gh!
There's a massive surge of magical energy at the core of the Leviathan…
m200592.…………ふっ。なるほどな。\nいいだろう。このわたしが、\nお前の期待に応えてや:
…………Heh. I see.
Very well. I, the one and only,
will live up to your expectations.
m200592.…………欲張りな娘に、育ったものだ。: ......She has grown into quite the greedy girl.
m200592.…………破滅の力って。\nこの世界にも破滅の力があるってこと！？:
...The power of destruction.
So this world has the power of destruction too!?
m200592.…………！\nそれは……そんなものを地上で用いたら……。:
…………!
If they use something like that on the surface…
m200592.…………？\nおや？ 今なにか物音が……。:
…………?
Oh? I heard a sound just now…….
m200592.…………？\nどうしてこちらを見ているの？:
…………?
Why are you looking at me like that?
m200592.……ああ、くそっ！\nまだ、ここで死んでたまるか……！:
...Ah, damn it!
I'm not going to die here...!
m200592.……あの飛竜が如き大地は、リヴァイアサン。\n世界を壊し、作り、大地を生み出す、:
……That earth like a flying dragon is Leviathan.
It is one of the primordial divine weapons
that destroys the world, creates it, and gives birth to the land.
m200592.……あれが、竜ノ国。\nラージヴィール卿、\nリヴァイアサンというのはいったい…:
……That is the Dragon Country.
Lord Rajvir,
what exactly is this Leviathan…
m200592.……いかがも何も、\nここまで寛大な沙汰を……。:
...What is there to say...
Such generous terms...
m200592.……おすすめはしない。\n今すぐここを離脱するのが得策なのは、\nお前たちだって:
……I wouldn't recommend it.
You know as well as I do that the smart move
is to leave here immediately, don't you?
m200592.……お前も変わり者だなぁ。\nまぁ、王国や天眼ノ国の連中もだが。:
……You're quite the odd one, aren't you?
Well, the Kingdom and the Celestial Eye folk are the same, though.
m200592.……かまわない。\nわたしはデーモンだ。いつかまた、復活できる。:
……It doesn't matter.
I am a Demon. I can resurrect again, someday.
m200592.……これが、いつも王子の見ている風景か。\n不思議と心が躍るな。:
……So this is the view the Prince always sees.
It's strange, but my heart is racing.
m200592.……すごい。\nずっと眠っているだけでは、\nこんな場面には、出会えませんでした:
……Amazing.
If I had just kept sleeping,
I never would have witnessed a scene like this.
m200592.……すごく痛いだろうし、苦しいはずなのに。\nそんなにしてまで、助けてあげたい人:
……It must hurt terribly, and be agonizing.
And yet, there's someone you want to save that badly.
m200592.……そなたが魔力を吸ったから、\n竜都の天竜核が出力を落としていたと？:
……You mean the Dragon Capital's Heavenly Dragon Core lowered its output
because you were draining its power?
m200592.……そのすべてだ。\n我が民を救ってくれたこと、\nどれだけ感謝してもし足りぬ…:
...It is all of that.
I cannot thank you enough
for saving my people...

I suppose Her Highness Lapis performed some kind of ritual...
m200592.竜都への接近に成功しました！\n王子、降下の準備をお願いします！:
We've successfully approached the Dragon Capital!
Prince, please prepare for descent!
m200592.管理頭脳を移すのとは根本の仕組みが異なりますから。\nレヴィアタンの魔力で肉体を:
The fundamental mechanism is different from transferring a management AI.
The correct approach is to have Leviathan's mana form a body, and then transfer a conversational personality into it.
m200592.美しい都を築き、密かに暮らしておる者たちだ。\n竜ノ国とは……まぁ、国交は一切結: A people who have built a beautiful capital and live in seclusion.
m200592.若ー！\nスカベンジャーの里方面も危ないよ！\nこちらの背後を取るために、標的に:
Sir!
The Scavenger Village front is in danger too!
It looks like they're using it as a decoy
to get behind us!
m200592.行きましょう、王子。\n何度も、国が落ちる様は見たくありませんから。:
Let us go, Prince.
I do not wish to see a nation fall, not once more.
m200592.被害状況は？: What's the extent of the damage?
m200592.見えた！ 砲弾……いや、\nドラゴンブレスみたいなものかも！\n火炎弾がばらまか:
I see it! A shell… no,
it might be something like dragon breath!
It's scattering fireballs!
m200592.話は最後まで聞きましょうよ。\nたぶん――死にますよ？:
Let's hear the whole story first.
You'll probably… die, won't you?
m200592.誰ガ、ゆっくり歩ケと言ッタ！\n足並ミヲ揃エテ急グノダ！\nバラバラに着イテハ、:
Who said we could walk slowly?
Match your steps and hurry!
If we arrive scattered, we're no reinforcements!
m200592.諸君、我ラゴブリン軍団、１３年の歩み！\n迅速ナル行軍ニテ見せつけるノダ！！:
Everyone, our Goblin Legion has a thirteen-year track record!
Let's show them what a swift march looks like!!
m200592.逃げろ！ こっちにも火が回るぞ！: Run! The fire's spreading this way too!
m200592.過大な要求だということは、わかっている。\nせめて、我が竜の首と引き換えに、我が:
I know this is an excessive request.
At the very least, in exchange for my dragon's head, please spare my people—
m200592.違います！\n完全な魔界の瘴気の逆位相です！！:
No!
It's the exact antiphase of pure Demon Realm miasma!!
m200592.鍵が壊れちゃったとか！？\n鍵開けと窃盗と強盗ならまかせて！:
Is the lock broken?
Leave the lockpicking, pickpocketing, and burglary to me!
m200592.頼るなら、今じゃない？: If we are to rely on it, isn't now the time?
m200592.馬鹿な……ドーンブリンガーの設計は、\n大神ディアスの魔力にすら対応しているんだ:
Ridiculous... Dawnbringer's design
is supposed to handle even the mana of the Great God Dias.
m200592.魔王ガリウスが引き起こしかけた、\n破滅の力による物質界の魔界化の再演だ。\nお:
It would be a replay of the demonization of the material world that the Demon King Galios nearly brought about.
The damage would likely be catastrophic.
m200592.魔界の瘴気ですら人体には悪影響がある。\n……デーモンやドラゴンには好ましい環境:
Even the miasma of the Demon Realm is harmful to the human body.
……Though it is a favorable environment for demons and dragons.
m200592.魔界の者にとっては、大地と対話するに等しいからな。: For those of the Demon Realm, it is akin to speaking with the earth itself.
m200592.（――ふふっ、いつか連合王国にだって）: (—Heh, someday, even the United Kingdom will…)
m200592.（……ここで死んでも、悔いはない。\n最期の瞬間が、王子と一緒なら怖くないから）:
(……Even if I die here, I have no regrets.
If my final moment is spent with the Prince, I am not afraid)
m200592.（……王国軍が大半の戦力を\n天眼ノ国へ集結させているんだから、\n今こそゴブリ:
(…With the Kingdom's army concentrating most of its forces
in the Heavenly Eye Kingdom, this is the perfect chance for the Goblins to conquer the world, isn't it?)
m200592.（……王子、ヤツの障壁を砕けるか。\nわたしの魔力を貸してやる）:
(……Prince, can you break his barrier?
I'll lend you my mana.)
m200592.（おそらく、これが最後の好機だ。\nヤツが破滅の力を集め始めたのなら、\n本来の:
(This is likely our last chance.
If he has begun gathering the power of Ruin,
he is trying to reclaim his power as a true god.)
m200592.（でも、まだ終わるつもりもない。\nだって、まだまだやりたいことが、いっぱいある:
(But, I have no intention of ending things just yet.
After all, I still have so many things I want to do)
m200592.（どこからかやってきた、王国の飛行戦力。\nそしてリヴァイアサンの能力を無効化し:
(Aerial forces from the Kingdom have arrived…
And someone who nullified Leviathan's power……)
m200592.（今ここで、仕留める。\nお前たちなら、できるはずだ。――行くぞ）:
(Finish him here and now.
You should be able to do it. —Let's go!)
m200592.（北の大国を豊かな国にするの。\n王子と一緒に、それぞれの国を、ふたりで）:
(To make the great northern kingdom a prosperous land.
With the Prince, we'll build our respective nations, side by side)
m200592.（最強の戦闘国家も、ここが死に場所か……）: (Even the strongest military power… is this where it ends?)
m200592.（障壁が砕けたら……あとは任せる。\n今この場で、神を殺せるのは\nグングニル、:
(Once the barrier breaks… the rest is up to you.
Only Gungnir, Fragarach, and Ansar can kill a god
in this place.)

m400140.――王子、此度は白の帝国、王国共同で行う\n軍事演習への申し入れに快諾頂いたこと: ――Prince, I want to express my gratitude once again for your gracious acceptance of the joint military exercise between the White Empire and the Kingdom.
m400140.そうだな、形式としては普段の\n魔物討伐の任とは違い『大討伐ミッション』\nとい: Right, as a format, unlike our usual monster-clearing missions, we'll be using a “Grand Hunt Mission.”
m400140.それでは『大討伐ミッション』開始とさせて頂く！: Now then, let the Grand Hunt Mission begin!
m400140.たとえライフが０になってもクリアとなり、\nそれまでに倒した数はカウントされ\n: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you defeated will be tallied as your battle record.
m400140.つまり、自軍の被害を恐れるよりも\n少しでも多くの相手を打ち倒す事に\n専念する: In other words, rather than worrying about your own losses, you should focus on slaying as many opponents as possible.
m400140.まず大討伐ミッションでは\n『敵を撃破すること』\nそれのみが唯一の目的となる。: First, the sole objective is simple: defeat the enemy.
m400140.また敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできない。\n: And defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or any drops, so keep that in mind.
m400140.今回の演習は帝国と王国、互いの戦力を知り\n共闘を学ぶ良い機会だ、貴公の国の兵も: This exercise is a great chance for the Empire and the Kingdom to learn each other's strengths and to fight together. Your troops will also be taking part.
m400140.兎に角一人でも多く相手を倒す、\nそれこそが最も重要だ。: The more foes you take down, the better—that's what matters most.
m400140.出撃コストが時間経過で回復しない事も留意しておけ。\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ: Also note that deployment cost doesn't recover over time. Make sure to include someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill and a Valkyrie in your sortie team.
m400140.場所については当帝国の領土内、\n新設した防衛拠点にて行う事になる。: The location will be within our empire's territory, at the newly established defensive outpost.
m400140.大討伐ミッションでは通常のミッションとは違い\n幾つか異なる点がある事に注意して: Keep in mind that a Grand Hunt Mission differs from regular missions in several ways.
m400140.有事の際には貴国の力を借りる事もあるだろう。\nその際に互いの力を知らない、\n: In times of crisis we may call upon your country's aid. It would be problematic if we didn't know each other's capabilities or couldn't coordinate.
m400140.此度の演習、王国帝国双方にとって\n意義のある演習となることを願っているぞ。: I hope this exercise proves meaningful for both the Kingdom and the Empire.
m400140.此度の演習の目的は、我が帝国軍の\n軍力向上、並びに貴国との連携の強化にある。: The purpose of this exercise is to improve our imperial forces and to strengthen cooperation with your nation.
m400140.演習とは言え、こちらとしても拠点の効果の程を試す\n絶好の機会だ。全力で当たらせ: Even though it's a drill, it's a perfect chance for us to test the outpost's effectiveness. We'll give it our all, so don't let your guard down either.

m400286.……んにゃッ？\n手伝う！？ 一緒に来てくれるのか？\nホントーだな？ ウソはキ: …Huh? You'll help? You'll actually come with me? Really? I hate lies.
m400286.あ、忘れるところだったぞ……あのな、敵を倒しても\nEXPやゴールド、ドロップ品: Oh, almost forgot… even if you defeat enemies, you won't get EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind!
m400286.あれ？\nアタシ、なんでこんなこと喋ってるんだ？\nえーっと、もっと大事な何かを: Huh? Why am I saying all this? I feel like I was trying to tell you something more important…
m400286.うぅーッ！！ どうすればいいんだ！！\n考えたりするのはキライだぞ！ 今はとにか: Ugh!! What should we do!! I hate thinking about it! All we can do now is neutralize the beasts and restore the forest's peace!
m400286.うぶるるる……いっぱいの魔獣と戦うのかと思うと、\nなんだか身体がぶるぶるってな: Ugh… thinking about fighting a ton of beasts makes my body start shaking…
m400286.そうだ！\n魔獣の森が大変なんだぞッ！\n森の魔獣達がとつぜん暴れだしたみたいな: Right! The Beast Forest is in trouble! The forest's beasts suddenly went berserk.
m400286.それなのに、魔獣が暴れだしたっていうことは……、\nもしかしたら森の魔物使いに何: So the fact that they're rampaging means… maybe something happened to the Beast Tamers. That worries me…
m400286.だから、ライフが0になってもクリアになるんだぞ。: That means you can clear it even if your life gauge hits zero.
m400286.だから自分達の仲間の被害を抑えるよりも、\nどれだけたくさんの敵を倒せるかってい: So it's more about how many foes you can take down than protecting our own side.
m400286.だけどな、今回の戦いは出撃コストが時間経過で\nは回復しないから注意が必要なんだ: But beware, the deployment cost for this fight doesn't recover over time.
m400286.はぁ、なんだかしゃべりすぎて疲れたぞ……。\nもー説明はおしまいだぞ！: Ha, I'm tired from talking so much… That's it for the briefing!
m400286.ほらー、はやく行こーよ？\nそうそう、アタシと一緒に\n魔獣たちを倒して森を静か: Come on, let's go already? Yeah, let's team up and clear out those beasts to quiet the forest!
m400286.もしアンタがやられちゃっても、それまでに倒した敵の数も\nカウントされて戦果とし: Even if you get taken down, the number of enemies you've defeated up to that point will still be counted and recorded as your battle result, so just focus on slaying as many as you can!
m400286.やっっったぞーッ！\n噂どおりのいいヤツだな！\nよーし、そうと決まれば早速森へ: Yes! Just like the rumors said, you're a great guy! Alright, now that it's decided, let's head to the forest!
m400286.ん？ どんなヤツか、だって？\nんーとね、獣人で、狩猟が得意で、あとはなぁ……\: Huh? You want to know what I'm like? Well… I'm a beast-person, good at hunting, and… oh! I hate shoes, so I never wear them! Yeah!
m400286.アンタと一緒ならたくさん頑張れる気がするぞ！\n仲間たちとも協力して、一体でも多: If I'm with you, I feel like I can push through a lot! Let's work with the others and take down as many foes as possible. I'm excited to see who can defeat more!
m400286.人間なんか餌のひとつくらいにしか考えてないんだぞ。\nそれを森の魔物使いが大人し: Humans are nothing more than a snack to them. The Beast Tamers kept them calm, but now…
m400286.今回の戦いは、とにかく敵をたくさん倒すことを\n目的とした『大討伐ミッション』な: This battle's goal is simple: a “Grand Hunt Mission” to slay as many enemies as possible.
m400286.倒すことに夢中になって部隊をどんどん展開して\nいくと、戦況が急に変わったときに: If you get too caught up in killing and keep deploying units, you might not be able to place allies when the battle suddenly shifts, so watch out for that.
m400286.大討伐ミッションていうのはだな、\n通常のミッションとはいくつか違う点が\nある: A Grand Hunt Mission differs from a normal mission in several ways, so you'll want to pay attention.
m400286.大討伐ミッションの最大の目的はだな、\nずばり『敵を撃破すること』なんだ！: The main objective is crystal clear—defeat the enemies!
m400286.怖いのか……だって？ ち、ちがうぞ！\nこれはワクワクの前のゾクゾクだ！\n大事: Scared? N-no, that's not it! This is the thrill before the excitement! It's normal to feel like this before an important battle!
m400286.普段は魔物使いが森の魔獣たちをぜーんぶ管理して、\n悪さしないようにしてるんだ。: Normally, the Beast Tamers keep all the forest beasts under control so they don't cause trouble.
m400286.最近じゃ、この近くの森にも魔獣がちらほら姿を\n見せるようになったし、もしかした: Lately, even the nearby woods have been showing up with stray beasts, and maybe they're being controlled by them…
m400286.準備はいいか？ いいよな？\nよーし、それじゃあ\n『大討伐ミッション』の始まり: Ready? You are? Alright, then—let the Grand Hunt Mission begin!
m400286.王子！ 一緒に森にきてくれよ！\nアタシ聞いたんだぞ！？\n王子はスゴく強くて、: Prince! Come with me into the forest! I heard it yourself—you're incredibly strong and kind to beast-people!
m400286.知ってるか？\n魔獣っていうのは、そもそも、とっても凶暴な獣たちなんだ。: Did you know? Beast-type monsters are inherently ferocious creatures.

m400514.――は、はい……。\nみなさんも、落ち着いて聞いて下さい。: —Yes... Everyone, please stay calm and listen.
m400514.……王国で、蝗害が発生しました。: ...A locust plague has broken out in the kingdom.
m400514.ああ、シロは東の国出身だっけ……。\n蝗害がほぼ発生しない地域だから、\n知らな: Ah, Shiro's from the eastern lands... It's a region where locust plagues hardly ever happen, so it's understandable if you haven't heard of it.
m400514.うんうん、そのとおり。\nただ、事態はそう単純じゃない。: Yeah, that's right. But the situation isn't that simple.
m400514.えぇ、事態は一刻を争います。\n王子、『大討伐ミッション』の発令を進言します！: Indeed, time is of the essence. Prince, I propose we issue a “Great Extermination Mission”!
m400514.こ、こうがい……？ ってなんでありますか？: L-locust plague...? What does that even mean?
m400514.それから、今回はある意味では\n自然災害への対処となります。: Also, in a sense this is dealing with a natural disaster.
m400514.それでは王子さま、急ぎ部隊編成をお願いします。\n王国の農地、この手で必ず守り抜: Then, Prince, please assemble the forces quickly. We'll protect the kingdom's farmland with our own hands!
m400514.ど、どうしたのエイル、そんなに慌てて！？: W-what's wrong, Eir, you're so flustered!?
m400514.はい……。\n王国軍本隊を投入しても、\n農村の被害を防ぐことができるかどうか…: Yes... Even if we commit the main royal army, we're not sure we can prevent damage to the farming villages...
m400514.ふむふむ……。\nあれ、でも魔物なら倒せばいいのでは？: I see, I see... But if they're monsters, can't we just defeat them?
m400514.もしこれを放置すれば、\n王国の食糧事情が破綻する可能性すらある。: If we leave this unchecked, the kingdom's food supply could collapse.
m400514.エイルの焦り方を見る限り、おそらく、\n警備部隊だけで対処できる規模ではないのね: Judging by how panicked Eir is, it's probably beyond what the guard units can handle alone, right?
m400514.敵を倒しても、EXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を入手することはできないと考えてく: Even if you defeat the enemies, consider that you won't obtain EXP, gold, or any drops.
m400514.目標は虫の魔物の数を可能な限り減らすことです。\n一体でも多くの敵を撃破すること: The objective is to reduce the number of insect monsters as much as possible. Focus on destroying as many enemies as you can.
m400514.簡単に言えば、虫の魔物の大量発生です。\nおびただしい量に膨れ上がった群れが、\: In short, it's a massive outbreak of insect monsters. Huge swarms swell up and devour crops right down to the roots.
m400514.緊急事態ですから、万全の補給体制は望めません。\n出撃コストが回復しないため、『: Because it's an emergency, we can't guarantee a full supply line. Since sortie costs won't recover, you'll need someone with “Reinforcement Request” or to form a Valkyrie unit.
m400514.魔物の数は非常に多いと予想されます。\nライフが０となっても、それまでに倒した敵: The monsters are expected to be extremely numerous. Even if your life reaches zero, the number of enemies you've defeated up to that point will be counted, so prioritize annihilating them.
m400514.魔物の群れが出たとか、\nどこかの村が襲われているとか？\nとにかく、落ち着いて: A swarm of monsters appeared, or a village is being attacked? Anyway, stay calm and report—
m400514.魔物の群れは人々を襲うけど、\n虫の魔物は、食物を枯らしていく。: The monster swarms attack people, but insect monsters just wither the food.

m500110.……え？ 一緒に来る？\n相手はあの魔神ビフロンスなのよ？\n生きて帰れる保証は: …Huh? You want to come with me? The opponent is that demon god Bifrons, you know. There's no guarantee we'll come back alive.
m500110.……ダーリン、ありがとう……。\n分かったわ。一緒に戦いましょう。\nもし、敗れ: …Darling, thank you. I understand. Let's fight together. Even if we're defeated, I'd rather perish by your side.
m500110.……ビフロンスについて知ってる事はないか？\nそうね、私が知っている限りの情報を: …Do you know anything about Bifrons? Alright, I'll tell you everything I know.
m500110.あ、あの～…、メトゥスさん…？\n王子たち行っちゃうよ…？: Um... Metus? The princes are about to leave...?
m500110.あら、ごめんなさいね。\n少しぼーっとしちゃってたわ。\nそれじゃ、私たちもダー: Ah, sorry about that. I was a bit spaced out. Well then, let's head back with Darling too!
m500110.このままだと、物質界が滅びる危険性があるわ。\n魔神は破壊と混沌を糧とする魔物…: If things continue as they are, the material world could be destroyed. The demon god feeds on destruction and chaos… I think everyone will be turned into undead.
m500110.これぐらいかしら、私が魔神ビフロンスについて\n知っている情報は…。: That's about all the information I have on the demon god Bifrons…
m500110.それじゃ、私はそろそろ行くわね。: Well then, I should be on my way.
m500110.それは、アンデッド同士を共鳴させ、\nアンデッド全員の戦闘力を底上げする能力なの: It lets undead resonate with each other, boosting the combat power of every undead under his command. He's even granted that ability to his subordinates.
m500110.だから、ビフロンスと戦う時は、\nまず共鳴する力を持っている部下たちを、\n真っ: So, when fighting Bifrons, the first thing to do is to take down the subordinates who possess that resonant power.
m500110.はぁぁ～…。\nや～っとビフロンス支配下のアンデッドを\nぜぇ～んぶ倒したわぁ～: Haa… Finally, I've wiped out every undead under Bifrons' control!
m500110.もう間もなく物質界に完全に姿を現すと思う。\n私は死霊術で対抗できないか試してみ: It won't be long before it fully reveals itself here. I'm planning to see if I can counter it with necromancy.
m500110.ダーリン。\n今日は大切な話があって来たわ。\n落ち着いて聞いてね。: Darling, I've come because I have something important to tell you. Listen calmly, okay?
m500110.ビフロンスは自身の肉体もアンデッド化する事で\n共鳴する力を自分に反映させる事が: By turning his own body into undead, Bifrons can reflect that resonant power back onto himself, giving him unimaginable strength.
m500110.リッチ…見ていてくれた…？\nあなたの仇は取ったわ…。: Rich... were you watching...? I've taken care of your foe...
m500110.不安？ ふふっ、顔に書いてあるわ。\n私は大丈夫、これまで皆に迷惑かけてきたから: Anxious? Heh, it's written all over your face. I'm fine—I've caused enough trouble for everyone already. I just want to help you and the humans, even a little.
m500110.不死者を統べる魔神ビフロンスが\n魔界から物質界に侵攻を開始したわ。: The demon god Bifrons, ruler of the undead, has begun its invasion from the demon realm into ours.
m500110.元々ビフロンスは魔界最高位のネクロマンサーでね、\n彼にしか扱えない死霊術がある: Originally, Bifrons was the highest-ranking necromancer in the demon realm, and he possesses a form of necromancy that only he can wield.
m500110.前にビフロンスに操られた時と同じ感覚がするのよ……。\nこの感じは間違いないわ。: It feels just like the last time we were controlled by Bifrons… I'm certain of this feeling.
m500110.完璧なネクロマンサーとして、\n私も少しは成長出来たかな…？: As a perfect necromancer, I guess I've grown a bit...?
m500110.王子、魔神が後退していきます！: Prince, the demon god is retreating!
m500110.私はダーリン…いえ、仲間達のおかげで、\n人間として前に進む事が出来たわ…。: Thanks to you, Darling... no, thanks to my comrades, I've been able to move forward as a human...
m500110.魔界のネクロマンサーなら\n魔界で大人しくしていなさいよね！\nまた来てもダーリ: If a demon-realm necromancer can't stay quiet in his own realm, then bring him back here! If he returns, Darling and I will drive him away again!
m500110.魔神ビフロンスを撃退出来て本当に良かったです。\nそれでは帰還するとしましょう。: I'm so glad we were able to repel the demon god Bifrons. Let's head back now.

m500586.――そちらのお二方、\n何をこそこそと話しているのでありますか？:
――The two of you over there,
what are you whispering about?
m500586.――ふぇ？ 影の帝国とまた戦うのでありますか？: ――Huh? Are we fighting the Shadow Empire again?
m500586.――今回は、黒星を付けられたか。: ――Looks like we took a loss this time.
m500586.――女皇陛下！ 一族の者は揃いました。\n皆、正々堂々と白の帝国とやりあえると気:
――Your Imperial Majesty! The clan has assembled.
We are all fired up, ready to give the White Empire a fair and square fight!
So, which front are we assigned to?
m500586.……もう次の話をしているのか。: ……Are you already talking about the next one?
m500586.……もしかして、レオナたちって\n仲が悪かったりします？: ……Do you and Leona get along badly, or something?
m500586.……対外的なパフォーマンス、ですね？: ……It's a show for the outside world, I suppose?
m500586.……影の帝国の実力を、\n第三国にも知らしめておけ、と。\n感謝いたします、アン:
……A chance to show the third nation the true strength of the Shadow Empire.
Thank you, Angeline.
m500586.……苦労するな、互いに。: ……You two have a lot to work through, don't you.
m500586.……鏡を見たことは？: ……Have you ever looked in a mirror?
m500586.ああ。待たせたな、オリジナル。\nこちらは皆、やる気に満ちているぞ。:
Ah. Sorry to keep you waiting, Original.
Everyone on our side is ready to go.
m500586.いえ。次も、大いに友好を深められそうだと。: Nothing. We're just looking forward to deepening our friendship further next time.
m500586.えぇ、そのようですわね。\nそれから、演習には王国軍も参戦します。\n――意味は:
Yes, it certainly seems so.
And the Kingdom's army will be joining the exercise as well.
――You understand what that means, don't you?
m500586.えぇ。一時的に緊張状態となりはしたものの、\n反乱の首謀者は、国外にて監視下に置:
Yes. Although tensions did rise for a time,
the ringleader of the rebellion agreed to be placed under surveillance abroad,
and furthermore, the warriors accepted the alliance with the White Empire.
m500586.ええ。これは、双方が合意した演習です。\nあなた方の土地も、家族の暮らしも、\n:
No. This is an exercise that both sides have agreed upon.
Your land and your families' lives
are not being wagered on the outcome.
m500586.ええ。影の帝国に属する巨人族の族長からも、\n一族を率いて参加したいと。:
Yes. The chieftain of the Giant tribe belonging to the Shadow Empire
also requested to lead his clan in the participation.
m500586.これは我ら、巨人族だけの戦いではありませぬ。\n「影の帝国」の民が、白の帝国に対:
This is not merely a battle for us Giants.
The people of the "Shadow Empire" are showing the White Empire
that warriors capable of shaking the nation exist here.
m500586.これは白の帝国内の小さな衝突であって、\n内部的にも対外的にも、全く問題はありま:
We have to make it clear that this was a minor conflict within the White Empire
and that there are no issues, either internally or externally.
m500586.さて、では王国へ帰るとしましょうか。\n愉快な人質生活が待っていますから。:
Well then, let's head back to the Kingdom.
Our pleasant life as hostages awaits us.
m500586.しかし、本当に戦を始めれば、\n守りたい家族まで危険にさらしてしまう。\nあの方:
However, if a real war were to start,
the very family he wants to protect would be put in danger.
They understand that too.
m500586.そちらは任せました。\nこちらも、できることをしておきますよ。:
I'll leave that side to you.
We'll be doing our part, too.
m500586.その言葉、そっくりお返しする。: I shall return that remark to you as is.
m500586.それならば、存分に戦えますな。\n一族の戦士たちにも、そう伝えます。:
If that is the case, we can fight with our full strength.
I will pass that along to the warriors of our clan.
m500586.それはそれとして、\n罪なき民に被害を拡大させる前に、\n平和的に事態を軟着陸さ:
That aside,
your skill in landing the situation peacefully
before the innocent people suffered further
is truly impressive.
m500586.ただ……想定外だったのは……。: It is just that... we did not expect...
m500586.ただ、それにしてもずいぶんな数ねぇ。\n戦士だけでなく、腕に覚えのある者が、\n:
Still, that's quite a large number, isn't it?
It looks like many are participating
who aren't just warriors, but have some skill with a weapon.
m500586.で、なぜいまになって\n白の帝国、影の帝国で戦うことに？:
So, why is it that we're fighting
the White Empire and the Shadow Empire now?
m500586.ですから、本気の殴り合いを、\n合法的に、仲良く実施する機会は重要なのです。:
That's why it is important to have an opportunity
to legally and amicably engage in a full-blown brawl.
m500586.では、双方悔いのないように。\n配置につきなさい！:
Then let both sides give it their all.
Take your positions!
m500586.どうやら、大変なのはここからのようですね。: It seems the real trouble starts from here.
m500586.ひぃっ！？\nやっぱ全然仲直りしてないでありますな！\nこの最悪な雰囲気！:
Eek!
I knew they weren't getting along at all!
This is the worst kind of atmosphere!
m500586.まぁ、個人的に思うところはありますし、\n勝手知ったる自分の思想、という感じで\:
Well, I do have my personal grievances,
and I'm not fond of having my own well-known philosophy
exploited to the fullest extent, but…
m500586.まずは事前の作戦会議どおりだ。\n敵を追って、味方から離れすぎるなよ。\n勇猛果:
First, follow the strategy we agreed upon earlier.
Do not chase the enemy so far that you stray from your allies.
Bravery is a virtue, but those who rush to their deaths will be severely punished.
m500586.一度で満足すると思ったか？\n同盟を結ぶのであれば、合同演習は何度もすべきだろう:
Did you think we'd be satisfied with just one?
If we're forming an alliance, we should be holding joint exercises over and over.
m500586.一族を率いて、か。\nやけに乗り気なのだな。:
Lead his clan, huh.
He seems surprisingly eager.
m500586.互いに思うところはあるだろうが、\nこちらも影の帝国も、被害の拡大は望まない。\:
We may both have our reservations,
but neither we nor the Shadow Empire want the damage to spread.
It's like a ritual to ensure we get along.
m500586.元女皇、です。\n配置はレオナから。:
It is "Former Empress" for you.
Leona will give you your positions.
m500586.全軍、前へ！\nその力を、白の帝国軍に叩きつけてやるのです！:
All units, advance!
We will crush that strength into the White Empire's army!
m500586.国家なんてそういうものですわ。\n建前がしっかりしていれば、内側がどうなっていて:
That is simply how nations work.
As long as the public face is maintained, things tend to run smoothly on the inside, no matter what.
m500586.壮健で。\nまた、すぐに会うことになると思いますが。:
In good health.
I imagine we'll see each other again soon.
m500586.委細承知！\n……しかし、その前にひとつだけ。:
Understood!
...However, before we start, there is one thing I must ask.
m500586.帝国に従いたくはない。故郷も捨てたくはない。\nあいつにとっては、どちらも譲れん:
He doesn't want to submit to the Empire. Nor does he want to abandon his homeland.
For him, neither is something he can give up.
m500586.我々を影の帝国側の将として立てるとはな。\n立場上、国外追放に等しい状況のはずだ:
For them to appoint us as generals for the Shadow Empire.
Given our positions, this is practically the same as being exiled from our homeland, is it not?
m500586.我らが敗れたとしても、本当に\n故郷を明け渡せと言われることは、ないのでしょうか:
Even if we are defeated, will we truly
be forced to hand over our homeland?
m500586.戦えぬ者たちが、\nようやく声をあげられる、か……。\n影の帝国を立ち上げたこと:
Those who could not fight
are finally given a voice to speak...
It seems establishing the Shadow Empire was worth it.
m500586.普段はまともなのだ。普段は。\nしかし、どうしても自分が相手だと\n日頃の鬱憤が:
She's usually sensible. Usually.
But when it comes to facing off against me,
her usual frustrations just come pouring out, I suppose.
m500586.民に、愛されていますね。: They are truly beloved by their people.
m500586.総員、抜剣！\n白の帝国の誇りと意志、いまこそ見せるとき！:
Everyone, draw your swords!
Now is the time to show the pride and will of the White Empire!
m500586.自分と同じ顔をした女を褒めるなんて、\nオリジナルは随分と自己愛が激しいのですね:
To praise a woman who looks exactly like me,
the original must have quite the ego, I see?
m500586.表向きには和睦を結んだのでは？\nそれとも、やっぱりボッコボコにすべきと――:
We supposedly signed a peace treaty, didn't we?
Or is it that you decided to beat them up anyway――
m500586.陛下にもお伺いしましたが、\n『影の帝国の民が強く望んだ以上、仕方あるまい』と。:
I inquired with Her Majesty, and she said,
"Since the people of the Shadow Empire desire it so strongly, there is nothing we can do about it."
m500586.頭の硬さは、きっとあなたに似たのですね。: Your stubbornness must surely resemble yours, I imagine.
m500586.（……伝えなくてもいいのか？\n他にも、影に連なる者がいることを）:
(……Should I really not tell them?
That there are others who follow the Shadow)
m500586.（伝える必要がありますか？\n我らとはまた異なる目的を持つ者たち。\nその悲願を:
(Is it necessary to tell them?
They are people with goals different from ours.
Who could possibly obstruct their ambitions in advance?)

m900368.――あっ、ようやく見つけましたよ！\nザエモン！ 執務室まで案内するから\n大人:
――Ah, I finally found you!
Gorozaemon! I told you to follow me quietly to the office, didn't I?
m900368.――あのー、そろそろ入っていーい？\n王子の武具ができたんだけどー？: ――Um, is it okay if we come in now? The Prince's new gear is ready!
m900368.――ひぃ……ひぃ……。\n酒甕、持ってきましたぁ……。:
――Eek… eek…
I brought the wine jars…
m900368.――よぉ、邪魔するぜ英雄王！\n……じゃなかった、今の時代は王子だったか？:
――Yo, hold up, Hero King!
…No, that's not it. In this day and age, it's the Prince, right?
m900368.――王子、今回はホントに助かったぜ。\n俺ひとりじゃァどうにもならなかったからな:
――Prince, I really owe you one this time.
I couldn't have done it alone.
m900368.――神刀・天羽々斬。\nこいつでどうだ？: ――The Divine Blade, Amatsuyoshi. How about that?
m900368.……それでは、そろそろ王国へ帰還しましょうか。\n王子、神獣ヤマタノオロチ討伐、:
……Then, it's about time we returned to the kingdom.
Well done, Prince, on defeating the divine beast Yamata no Orochi!
m900368.……地道に皆で運ぶか？: …Should we just carry them over slowly, all together?
m900368.あぁ、そいつぁちっと理由があってな。\n今回もその「理由」のせいで訪ねて来たんだ:
Ah, there's a bit of a reason for that.
I've come here because of that same “reason” this time, too…
And quit calling me the strongest. It makes me itch.
m900368.ああ、だがそれも暴走しちまえば終いさ。\nさぱっと俺たちで、その伝説を終わらせて:
Ah, but if it goes berserk, it's all over.
Let's put an end to that legend, right here and now.
m900368.ああ、神獣ヤマタノオロチは、\n他の神獣と同じく「神の威光」の力を持ってやがる。:
Ah, yes. Like the other divine beasts, Yamata no Orochi
wields the power of the “Divine Radiance.”
m900368.あいつ、自分が酒に弱いことをよく知ってるからな。\n絶対に自分から触れようとはし:
It knows full well how weak it is to alcohol.
It won't dare try to touch her on its own.
m900368.あっ、待って待って！\n僕も手伝うからー！！:
Ah, wait, wait!
I'll help out too!!
m900368.あれが、神獣ヤマタノオロチなんですね……。\n伝承によれば、東の国を守護した\n:
So that's the divine beast Yamata no Orochi…
According to legend, it was the strongest divine beast,
guarding the eastern lands.
m900368.い、いつも通りってことだな！\n王子、とにかく急がねぇとヤバイぞ！！:
S-So, just like always, huh!
Prince, we're in serious trouble if we don't hurry!!
m900368.い、良いんでしょうか……。\n一応東の国を守護していた存在ですが……。:
I-is that really okay…?
It was a being that guarded the Eastern Lands, after all…
m900368.いや、せっかく久々に目が覚めたんだ。\nしばらく諸国漫遊でもしてから、\n自分の: No, actually. Since I've finally woken up after so long, I think I'll travel around the various lands for a while before deciding where to go next.
m900368.いや、そこは気にしなくていい。\n酒甕を持ってるトトノ嬢に、\nヤツは神の威光の:
No, don't worry about that.
The Divine Radiance shouldn't be able to affect Miss Totono
while she's holding the wine jars.
m900368.いやいや、ここはダチの城だぞ？\nいまさら案内なんざされなくても\n迷わずここま:
Hey, now, this is your buddy's castle, isn't it?
I could find my way here without a guide,
even if you don't show me around.
m900368.うっ……はぁ……。\n自分で言い出したことですから、\n最後までやり遂げましょう:
Ugh... haah...
I'm the one who suggested this, so
I'll see it through to the end.
m900368.えぇと、ホムラさんご存知なのですか……？: Um, you know who he is, Homura?
m900368.おうトトノ嬢、よくやってくれた！\nこの酒甕はオロチ対策の要だからな、\n大事に:
Good work, Miss Totono!
These jars are the key to dealing with the Orochi,
so I'm glad you got them here safely.
m900368.おぉ、悪い悪い。\nつい昔の癖で名乗りもせずに入ってきちまった。:
Oh, my bad, my bad.
Old habits die hard. I just barged right in without introducing myself.
m900368.おぉ、異国の響きだ……！ かっこいい！: Oh, it has such a foreign ring to it…! It's so cool!
m900368.おそらく、魔王との戦いの余波で、\n封印を守っていた巨岩に影響が出たのでしょうね: It is likely that the aftermath of the war with the Demon King affected the giant boulder that was maintaining the seal…
m900368.おっ、ヤマタノオロチの鱗を武具にしたのか？\n現代の鍛冶職人もやるじゃねぇか！: Oh, you used Yamata no Orochi's scales for the gear? Not bad for a modern blacksmith!
m900368.こいつは出直すしかない！\nヤマタノオロチの魔力の直撃なんざ、\n人が耐えられる:
We have no choice but to retreat!
A direct hit from Yamata no Orochi's magic power
is something no human can withstand!!
m900368.こいつも、形を変えて未来を守れるなら本望だろうさ。\n鱗でも牙でも有効利用してや:
If it can protect the future in another form, that would be its wish, too.
Let's put its scales and fangs to good use.
m900368.さぁ獲物を倒したんだ、\n戦利品をがっつり持っていきな！:
Now that we've taken down the prey,
go ahead and take a good haul of the spoils!
m900368.し、神獣が、お酒を呑むんですね……。\nそういうことなら、私の取引ルートを使って:
A divine beast… drinks alcohol…?
If that's the case, I'll use my trade routes
to gather a massive amount of alcohol.
m900368.しかし、神獣が相手ですか……。: But the opponent is a divine beast…
m900368.しらふの時には……？\nえぇと、それはいったいどういう……？:
When it's sober…?
Um, what exactly does that…?
m900368.じゃあ王子、天羽々斬を装備する時には、\n称号を『遠呂智を断つ者』に変えてね！: Then, Prince, when you equip Amatsuyoshi, please change your title to “The Slayer of Yamata no Orochi”!
m900368.す、すげぇ……あのヤマタノオロチを、\nあの山ン本五郎左衛門と一緒に討伐しちまっ:
W-wow… We actually defeated that Yamata no Orochi,
alongside that Sanmoto Gorozaemon…
m900368.そういうことなら！\nミスリアちゃんの出番だー！:
If that's the case!
This is Mithria-chan's time to shine!
m900368.そういうわけだから、\nトトノ嬢は酒瓶に隠れながら、\nひぃこら戦場まで酒を運ん:
That's why, Miss Totono, hide behind the wine bottles
and bring the alcohol to the battlefield.
m900368.そうそう。他の英傑連中が生きてる保証もなし、\nじゃあ英雄王の子孫に頼るしかない:
Right, right. With no guarantee that any of the other Heroes are still alive,
there's no one else to turn to but the Hero King's descendant.
m900368.そこで、英雄王の子孫である、\n王子の協力を仰ごうと考えたのですね。:
So you decided to seek the help of the Prince,
descendant of the Hero King.
m900368.その上、ヤマタノオロチは\nシラフの時にゃ、手を付けられないくらい強いときた。:
On top of that, when Yamata no Orochi is sober,
it's too powerful to even scratch.
m900368.それが千年弱で目を覚ますんですから、\nもう本当に慌てましたとも……。: And yet you woke up just a thousand years later. I was truly in a panic…
m900368.ただ、問題は神の威光ですよ。\n酒甕を持ったまま転移させられたら、\nさすがに何:
The problem is the Divine Radiance.
If I get teleported while carrying the wine jars,
I definitely don't have the stamina to keep coming back here.
m900368.ただ、本当に重いので運べる数にも限度があります。\n王子、慎重に扱ってくださいね:
That said, they're really heavy, so there's a limit to how many I can carry.
Prince, please handle them with care...?
m900368.だが、ここ最近の魔力の異常で、\nヤマタノオロチを封じていた巨岩が砕けちまった。:
But with the recent surge in magical energy,
the giant rock that held Yamata no Orochi in place has shattered.
m900368.で、この後はどうするつもりですか？\nまた東の国で妖怪たちを束ねて、悪さを働くな: So, what are you planning to do now? If you're going to head back to the Eastern Lands to rally the yokai and cause trouble again—
m900368.でも、近くに置かれると呑んじゃうんですね……。\nなんだか親しみが持てるような…:
But if it's placed nearby, it'll just drink it…
It's starting to feel a bit like a friend…
m900368.ところで、この武具名前がないんだけど……。\nザエモンっち、何かいい名前ない？: By the way, this gear doesn't have a name yet… Gorozaemon, do you have any good name ideas?
m900368.ともあれ、これでこの辺りの集落も安全だ。\n手伝ってくれてホントに感謝してるぜ。:
Anyway, the settlements around here are safe now.
I really appreciate your help.
m900368.な、何ですかこの魔力！\n強大すぎて揺らぎの感知すらできませんよ！:
W-What is this magic power!
It's so immense I can't even detect the fluctuations!
m900368.はっ……はぁっ！？\nさんもとごろーざえもんッ！？\nまじか！？ あの伝説の妖怪:
Hah… Haah!?!
Sanmoto Gorozaemon!?!
You're for real! The legendary demon chieftain, Sanmoto Gorozaemon!
m900368.へっへー。\n鎧と刀、両方打ってみたよー。: Heh heh. I tried making both armor and a sword.
m900368.へへっ、実はな、あいつは酒が大好物なんだ。\nっつーわけで、好物の酒をたらふく呑:
Heh, here's the thing: that beast loves booze.
So if we get it drunk on its favorite drink,
we can weaken it. That's the plan.
m900368.ほぉ、知ってたか天狗の小娘。\n千年戦争の後、暴走しちまったあいつを、\n俺ァこ:
Hoo, so you knew, you little Tengu girl.
After the Millennium War, that thing went berserk.
I used my own body as a wedge to seal it away.
m900368.まったく、突然姿を見せるからびっくりしましたよ。\n封印される時、何て言ったか覚:
Honestly, you scared me by appearing out of nowhere.
Do you remember what you said when it was being sealed?
m900368.めちゃくちゃ加工が大変だったけどね……。\nさすがは伝説の神獣だよ。: It was incredibly difficult to process, though… Just as expected for a legendary divine beast.
m900368.よぉし、それじゃ俺は旅に出るぜ。\nまた会った時には、酒でも酌み交わそうな、王子: Alright, I'm off on my travels then. Next time we meet, let's share a drink, Prince!
m900368.よしッ！ それじゃあオロチ討伐といざ参らん！\n王子、頼りにしてるぜぇ！:
Good! Then let's go take down the Orochi!
I'm counting on you, Prince!
m900368.よっしゃ、それじゃあヤマタノオロチ討伐を始めるか！\n王子、封印しかできなかった:
Alright, then let's get started on subduing Yamata no Orochi!
Prince, surpass the limits of those of us who could only seal it,
using your true strength!!
m900368.よっしゃ、王子そいつをぶった斬れ！！\n伝説を終わらせるのがテメェの仕事だッ！！:
Alright, Prince, cut that thing in two!
It's your job to end the legend!!
m900368.わりぃわりぃ。\nだが俺も、そう簡単に封印を\n解かせるつもりはなかったんだぜ？: My bad, my bad. But I wasn't about to let that seal be broken so easily, you know?
m900368.んやぁ、王国も発展したモンだなぁ♪\n昔はもっと地味っていうか質素っていうか――:
Heh, the kingdom's really come a long way, huh? ♪
Back in the day, it was a lot more… modest. Or plain, I guess.
m900368.ん？ おぉ？\nそうだなぁ……じゃあ東の国の伝承にあやかって――: Hm? Oh? Let's see… How about we take a cue from the legends of the Eastern Lands—
m900368.チッ……まずいぞ王子！\nヤマタノオロチが魔力を集め始めた！:
Tch... This is bad, Prince!
Yamata no Orochi has started gathering its magic power!
m900368.ハッハ！ あん時ァ楽しかったなぁ……。\nあいつの子孫が生きてるんだから、\nま: Ha ha! That was a good time… Since his descendants are still around, it wouldn't be the worst idea to lend them a hand again…
m900368.ヤツの封印に、大妖怪たる俺の\n妖力が根こそぎ必要だった最大の原因だ！:
It's the main reason why sealing it required
absolutely all of my power as a great yokai!
m900368.ヤマタノオロチは魔力を練り上げて、\n周囲一体を薙ぎ払う力を持ってやがるんだよ！:
Yamata no Orochi refines its magic power into the force
to sweep away everything in its vicinity!!
m900368.今はあれから千年弱経っているんですから！\n門兵が慌てふためいて大変でしたよ！\:
It's been almost a thousand years since then!
The gate guards were in an absolute panic!
Haa… I can't believe it…
m900368.俺ァあいつのしっぽを\nぶった斬るのが精一杯だったからなァ。: I could barely manage to chop off its tail, you know.
m900368.俺ァ山ン本五郎左衛門。\nまっ、ごろーざえもんとでも呼んでおくれや。:
I'm Sanmoto Gorozaemon.
You can just call me Gorozaemon, if you like.
m900368.千年戦争で頑張りすぎたし、\n軽く一万年くらいヤマタノオロチと\n昼寝してくるわ: I pushed myself too hard in the Millennium War, so I figured I'd take a little nap with Yamata no Orochi—maybe a ten-thousand-year kind of thing, I think?
m900368.妖怪でその名を知らぬ者はいねェ！\n伝説のアヤカシにして、最強の怪異！:
No demon alive doesn't know that name!
The legendary Yōkai, the strongest of the supernatural!
m900368.山ン本五郎左衛門が封じた神獣……。\nま、まさかヤマタノオロチか！？:
The divine beast sealed by Sanmoto Gorozaemon…
Could it be… Yamata no Orochi?!
m900368.当時は英雄王が手伝ってくれたおかげで\n何とか封印までこぎ着けたんだが……。\n:
Back then, the Hero King helped me out,
and we managed to complete the seal…
But I can't do it all on my own, no matter how I try.
m900368.待て待て！ 俺がまるで悪ガキだったみてぇじゃねぇか！: Hold on, hold on! You're making me sound like a delinquent!
m900368.王子くん、ともあれ緊急事態なのです。\n彼女――サンモトゴローザエモンが、\nそ:
Prince, in any case, this is an emergency.
She—Sanmoto Gorozaemon—
has awakened the divine beast she sealed within her own body.
m900368.神獣のしっぽを、\n単騎でぶった斬るのもどうかしてるぜ……。: Cutting off a divine beast's tail on your own is just as insane, though…
m900368.英雄王たちが苦労したのも、\n強制的に転移させられるあの力のせいだったからな。:
That's what made things so difficult for the Hero King and his men.
They were constantly being forcibly teleported by that power.
m900368.英雄王に喧嘩売りに来たの、忘れてませんからね？\nまぁ、その後酒の趣味があうから: I certainly haven't forgotten that you came to pick a fight with the Hero King. Though, I do remember that you became allies almost immediately after discovering you had similar tastes in drinks…
m900368.英雄王は何でもできるヤバイヤツだったが……。\nへへっ、王子、\nテメェは不可能:
The Hero King was a dangerous guy who could do anything, but…
Heh, Prince,
you're a dangerous guy who makes the impossible possible!
m900368.荒ぶる妖怪共をぶん殴って従え、\n一大勢力を築いたっていう大妖怪だ！\nただ、千:
He beat the unruly demons into submission and built a massive power base!
But I hear he vanished after the Millennium War…
m900368.速攻で！ できるだけ早くぶち倒せ！！: Quick! Take it down as fast as you can!!
m900368.離れていても、周囲の魔力が震えているのが分かります。\nこんな強力な神獣、見たこ:
Even from here, I can feel the surrounding magical energy trembling.
I've never seen a divine beast this powerful…
m900368.（こいつ、喧嘩強いヤツと酒に強いヤツ大好きだからな。\nなんだかんだ言ってすぐ戻: (That guy loves strong fighters and heavy drinkers. I'm betting he'll come back around sooner or later, no matter what he says.)
m900368.（と言いつつ、すごい王子くんの方見てますね。\nめちゃくちゃ気に入ったんじゃない: (And yet, he's staring at the Prince quite a bit. I bet he really took a liking to him.)

m920012.『刻水晶』を私にお渡し下されば、その力を使って\n父の兵法を受け継ぎ、軍師として: If you hand me a Carved Crystal, I might use its power to inherit my father's tactics and serve you as a strategist.
m920012.あの魔物たちの統率された動きは……\nいやな予感がします。: The coordinated movements of those goblins... I have a bad feeling.
m920012.ここが敵の拠点のようです。\n兵法書を奪った魔物たちの主が出るやも\nしれません: This appears to be the enemy's stronghold. The leader of the monsters who stole the tactics tome might show up.
m920012.この上は父の後を継ぎ、軍師として\nいつか王子にお仕えすべく、兵法を\n学びます: From now on, I will succeed my father, study strategy, and someday serve you as a chief strategist.
m920012.この大軍を退けるとは……お見事です。\n敵が撤退を開始します。\n追撃の準備を。: Turning back such a massive army… splendid work. The enemy is beginning to retreat. Prepare to pursue.
m920012.しかし、数日前に魔物たちの襲撃を受け\n父は命を落とし、私だけが生き残ってしまい: However, a few days ago the goblins attacked. My father was killed, and I alone survived.
m920012.それでは、またお会いできる日を楽しみに\nしております。: Until then, I look forward to the day we meet again.
m920012.それと、兵法書を奪った魔物たちは\n『刻水晶』を所持していることがあるようです。: Also, the goblins that stole the treatise seem to possess a “Carved Crystal.”
m920012.それにしても魔物は兵法書などを\n奪ってどうするんでしょうね。: I wonder what the goblins intend to do with a tactics tome.
m920012.ただ気にかかるのは魔物たちが\n父の書き記した『兵法書』を奪っていったこと……。: What troubles me is that the goblins took my father's written treatise on tactics...
m920012.どうか取り戻してはいただけないでしょうか。: Could you please retrieve it for me?
m920012.まさか戦術の勉強でもするんでしょうか。: Could they be studying battle strategies?
m920012.ようやく人里までたどり着けた……\nお父様のおかげでレンは\n命を拾うことができ:
We've finally made it to a village...
Thanks to my father, I was able to cling to life.
m920012.ミツケタ！\nオマエ、オウサマガ\nヨンデル！:
Found you!
You, you shall die!
m920012.一刻も早く敵を撃退しなければ！: We must drive them out immediately!
m920012.不測の事態に即応するために\n常に兵力に余力を残しておくことが肝要。\nご注意く: To respond to unforeseen events, it's essential to keep reserves in your forces. Please be careful.
m920012.今回の魔物の動き。\n今までとは違うような気がします。: The monsters' movements this time… I feel they're different from before.
m920012.優秀な指揮官がいるようです。\nいたずらに戦えば被害が広がるのみ……\n砦にて迎: It seems we have an excellent commander. If we fight recklessly, only the damage will spread… Let's meet them at the fortress.
m920012.先ほどの魔物……父と私を襲撃した魔物で\nございました。: Those monsters earlier… they were the ones who attacked my father and me.
m920012.兵法書を取り返していただけるだけでなく\n父の仇まで取っていただけるとは……。: Not only have you recovered the tactics tome, but you've also avenged my father…
m920012.初めまして\n私はレン。:
Nice to meet you
I am Ren.
m920012.敵の別動隊が集落の内部まで\n侵入してしまいました。: An enemy detachment has infiltrated the settlement itself.
m920012.敵は数に任せた攻撃をしてくるようです。\n空を飛ぶ敵も多数いるようです。\nお気: The enemy appears to rely on sheer numbers. There are also many aerial foes. Please be careful.
m920012.敵は機動力に優れた部隊をそろえたようです。\nいかに速かろうが侵攻ルートを先読み: The enemy has assembled highly mobile units. No matter how fast they are, if we can anticipate their invasion routes, they won't be a threat.
m920012.敵は飛び道具ばかりの部隊をそろえたようです。\n装甲が厚い者で敵の注意を引き、こ: The enemy's forces consist mainly of projectile units. Use heavily armored units to draw their attention, and we'll respond with projectiles as well.
m920012.未熟な私では王子のお役に立つことはないでしょう。\n本来ならば私が命を賭しても父: In my inexperience I can't be of any help to you, Prince. I should have protected my father even at the cost of my own life...
m920012.父は戦争術、兵法に通じており\nかつて、今は亡き我が故国で\n長年軍師として仕え: My father was well-versed in warfare and strategy, having served as a long-time chief adviser in my homeland before it fell.
m920012.王子、焦りは禁物です。\n伏兵が隠れているやもしれません。: Prince, haste will only hurt you. There may be ambushers hidden.
m920012.王子、魔物たちに襲われていた\n旅人が王子に謁見を求めています。: Prince, a traveler who was attacked by goblins is requesting an audience with you.
m920012.王子のお力になりたいと\n父とともにこの国を目指し\n旅をしてまいりました。: My father and I set out for this kingdom, hoping to aid Your Highness.
m920012.近年は隠居の身でありましたが\n軍事戦略の追究は止むことなく\n必ずや王子のお役: These days he's retired, but his pursuit of military strategy never wanes, and I'm certain I can be of service to you...
m920012.魔物たちにとって書物など、\n価値があるものとは思えませんが\n今となっては大切: Goblins don't care for books, but that tome is now my father's cherished heirloom...
m920012.魔物の集団が近づいてきます！: A horde of goblins is approaching!

m920025.……お願いだ。\n私の死に場所を奪わないでもらえないだろうか。\nでは、失礼する:
…Please.
Could you at least let me choose my own place to die?
Well, I'll take my leave.
m920025.あなたの側であなたの身を案じている\n存在から目を背けないでください。: Don't turn away from those who worry about you by your side.
m920025.あなたは本当に失うものがないと\n考えているのですか？: Do you truly think you have nothing to lose?
m920025.あなた方と共に戦うことで、あの頃のようなシュウカ様を\n取り戻せるかもしれない…: By fighting alongside you, maybe we can bring back the Shuuka of old…! Prince, please…!
m920025.あなた方と出会えてよかった。\n心から礼を言う。:
I'm glad I met you all.
I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
m920025.あなた方のおかげで国を滅ぼした\n魔物を倒し、復讐という悪しき心に\nも打ち克つ: Thanks to you, we defeated the monster that destroyed the kingdom and overcame the vengeful darkness within me.
m920025.あの巨体から繰り出される一撃は\n城壁すら砕き破壊します。: A single blow from those massive bodies can shatter even our walls.
m920025.あの方は知略のみならず武にも長けている人。\nこのまま無謀な戦いに身を投じ続けれ:
She's not only a master of strategy but also skilled in combat.
If she keeps throwing herself into reckless battles, she'll eventually lose her life for real.
m920025.あの武器を持たない青い巨人はなんだ？\n初めて見る……。:
What are those blue giants without weapons?
I've never seen anything like that before.
m920025.あらら。あなた達はどちら様？\nここは私たち高貴な生まれの姫\nしか入れないとこ: Well now. Who might you be? This is a place only we noble-born princesses may enter.
m920025.あれはアタシたちの国を襲った巨人たち！: Those are the giants that assaulted our nation!
m920025.いくらシュウカ様でも相手が\n悪すぎます！: Even you, Shuuka, they're far too dangerous!
m920025.うるさい！\n…………わかったようなことを言うな！: Shut up! ……Don't speak as if you understand!
m920025.お姫様だと思って油断しないでくださいね。\n私たちの持つ伝説の宝剣は\nどれも魔: Don't let your guard down just because you're a princess. All the legendary swords we wield are imbued with magical power.
m920025.これからの戦いでもきっと、自ら最前線に\n立とうとするでしょうね。: Even in the battles to come, I'm sure she'll still try to put herself on the front lines.
m920025.これは私の戦いだ。\n先ほど手を貸してくれたことに感謝はしているが、\nここから:
This is my fight.
I'm grateful for the help you gave me earlier, but from here on out, I don't need any more assistance.
m920025.しかし、もう我慢ならん。\n愛すべき祖国を奪った魔物たちには、刺し違えてでも\n:
But I can't endure it any longer.
The monsters that stole our beloved homeland must pay, even if it means stabbing them to death—otherwise I can't face the comrades who died.
m920025.しかし、今は心強い仲間がいる。\n私たちの力を見せてやろう！:
But for now we have reliable allies.
Let's show them our strength!
m920025.しかし、私たちの国を襲った\n魔物たちは今ので最後ではない。: However, the monsters that attacked our kingdom weren't the last.
m920025.すいません。そうとは知らず。\n道に迷ってしまいました。: Sorry, I didn't know. We got lost.
m920025.そうね。\n貴方が本当に英雄の末裔なのか\n試させていただきます。: Indeed. We'll put your claim to the test.
m920025.だが、ここを抑える事ができれば\n敵の追っ手も一時は収まるはず。: But if we can hold this ground, the enemy's pursuers should subside for a time.
m920025.だが影自体は魔物本体を倒せば消える。\n戦場をかき乱される前に\n本体へ攻撃を集: But the shadows vanish once you defeat the monster itself. Focus your attacks on the main body before the battlefield gets thrown into chaos!
m920025.ですね。 私も同感です。\n私たちがそれを黙って許すとでも？:
Indeed. I feel the same.
As if we'd just stand by and let that happen?
m920025.では、共同戦線はその魔物を倒すまで\nという事でよろしいですか？: Then, shall we agree to keep the joint front until that monster is slain?
m920025.とにかく、本体を探しだすしかなさそうです。\nこれ以上の侵攻を許すわけにはいきま: In any case, we have to find the true body. We can't let any more invasion slip by! Prince, prepare for battle!
m920025.なぜ怒るのですか？\n先ほどの戦いはお互いが協力したからこそ\n勝てたのかもしれ: Why are you angry? Perhaps we won the earlier battle because we cooperated.
m920025.なるほど、みなに伝令を。\n攻撃を本体に集中してください。: I see. Send word to everyone: concentrate your attacks on the main body.
m920025.なんだぁ、お前は？\n人がいねぇ村に行く理由なんざ、\n金目の物を取りに行く他に:
What? Who are you?
There's no reason to go to an empty village except to take whatever valuables are there, right?
m920025.はっ！ 邪魔をするってのなら容赦しねぇ！\n野郎ども！！ かかれぇっ！:
Hah! If you're getting in our way, we won't show any mercy!
You bastards!! Charge!!
m920025.へえ。でも貴方本当に英雄の末裔なのですか？\nねぇシェリー。\nもしかして嘘つい: Hmm. But are you really a hero's descendant? Hey, Sherry, maybe they're lying!
m920025.まして、アタシたちの国を攻め滅ぼした魔物は\n腕力が強くて、いかにシュウカ様とい: Moreover, the monsters that razed our country are incredibly strong—no matter how capable Shuuka is, taking a direct hit from them would be downright dangerous.
m920025.もちろん私は最後まで戦おうと決めたのだが、\n従者のシャオが口うるさく戦ってはな: I was determined to fight to the bitter end, but my attendant Xiao kept nagging me that I shouldn't fight, so I've been forced to live in shame up to this point.
m920025.もっと強大で恐ろしい力を持った\n魔物が控えている。\nそいつを倒すまで私の戦い: Even stronger, more terrifying monsters lie in wait. My fight won't end until we defeat them…
m920025.やっと追いついたぞ。\n本隊の到着を待つ必要もない。\nあの国の生き残りは全て叩: Finally caught up. No need to wait for the main force. I'll crush every survivor of that nation.
m920025.アタシにはシュウカ様の従者として、\nあの方をお守りする使命があるけれど……。\:
As Shuuka's attendant, it's my duty to protect her, but…
Honestly, I'm acutely aware of my own shortcomings.
m920025.アタシはシュウカ様の従者、シャオ。\nさっきは助けてくれてありがとう。\nあと、:
I'm Xiao, Shuuka's attendant.
Thanks for helping us out earlier.
And, well, I'm sorry about everything.
m920025.オマエたち絶対に許さん！\n跡形もなくなるまで\nぶっ潰してくれるっ！！:
We will never forgive you!
We'll crush you until nothing remains!!
m920025.オレノ妖気ヲ最大マデ高メタ術ダ！！\nオマエタチ全員ヲ潰ス！\n潰ス！ 潰ス！！: I'll raise my demonic aura to the limit!! I'll crush every one of you! Crush! Crush!!
m920025.グフフフフ……。\nわが妖術見せてくれる。\nさあ、影どもよ敵を滅ぼせ。: Guffufufu… Let me show you my sorcery. Come, shadows, destroy the enemy.
m920025.グフフフフ……。\n少しはやるようだな。\nここはいったん退却だ。: Guffufufu… You're putting up a fight. We'll retreat for now.
m920025.ゴモモモモ！！\nオマエたちだな……。\n可愛い弟を倒したのは！:
Gomomommo!!
It's you…
You defeated my cute little brother!
m920025.シャオ！ 手を離せ！\n私はこれ以上は逃げぬぞ！！: Xiao! Let go of me! I won't run any further!!
m920025.シュウカ様。\nそれって前に倒した\n黒い牛頭の魔物では？:
Shuuka-sama.
Could it be the black Ox-Head Monster we defeated earlier?
m920025.シュウカ様とアタシは、この広大な砂漠の\n向こうにあった国からここまで逃げてきた: Shuuka and I fled from our homeland, which lay beyond this endless desert, all the way here.
m920025.シュウカ様！ 追っ手が来ています。\nこちらへお逃げください！: Shuuka! Pursuers are coming. Get over here!
m920025.今のシュウカ様は、アタシたちの国を滅ぼした魔物への\n復讐こそが生きる糧となって: These days, revenge against the monsters that annihilated our nation has become the very thing that keeps Shuuka alive.
m920025.今度いらっしゃる時は正式に\n王宮までご連絡くださいね！: Next time you come, be sure to contact the palace officially!
m920025.以前のシュウカ様はとても優しくて、そして強い人だった。\n団結すること、協力する:
The Shuuka I once knew was gentle and strong.
She always taught us that unity and cooperation are our true power, and I still remember those words today.
m920025.初めての敵に対して\n用心するにこした事はない。\n青い巨人の動きに注意せよ！:
When facing a new enemy, it's best to be cautious.
Watch the movements of those blue giants!
m920025.勝つためには貴公たちの協力が必要だ。\n頼む。力を貸してくれ。: We need your cooperation to win. Please, lend us your strength.
m920025.勝敗は関係がないのだ！\nわが国を滅ぼした魔物たちは\n私の手で倒さなければなら: Victory doesn't matter! The monsters that destroyed my kingdom must be slain by my own hand!
m920025.国王陛下の仇……。\nわが命に代えても必ず！: Vengeance for the king… even if it costs my life, I'll see it through!
m920025.報告します。\n敵部隊が接近中、まっすぐこちらに\n向かってきます。: Report. Enemy forces are approaching, heading straight for us.
m920025.報告！ あの魔物が放った\n影についてですが、見分けが\nつかなくなっているよう: Report! It seems we can't tell the shadow that monster released apart from anything else!
m920025.報告！ 牛頭の魔物の数が\n増えているようです。: Report! The number of Ox-Head Demons seems to be increasing.
m920025.大丈夫、私たちにまかせてください。\n守ってみせます。: Don't worry, leave it to us. We'll protect them.
m920025.大変です！ 巨人の群れが\nこちらに向かっています！: This is terrible! A horde of giants is heading straight for us!
m920025.妖術で発生した影を消すには\n弟の時と同じく、本体を叩けばいいはずだ。\nやつに:
To dispel the shadow created by sorcery, just like with my brother, we just need to strike the source.
Focus your attacks on it!
m920025.妖術を以てしても倒せないなんてな。\n本気を出さないといけないようだな！: Even with sorcery you can't defeat me. Looks like you'll have to get serious!
m920025.弟ノ仇……。\n絶対ニ許サン\n叩キ……潰ス……！！: My brother's grudge… I'll never forgive! I'll strike… crush…!!
m920025.弟？ 可愛い？\n誰の事を言っている。\nそんなやつ見たことがない！！:
Brother? Cute?
Who are you talking about?
I've never seen anyone like that!!
m920025.影の数がさらに増えた上に\n敵の兵力も増しています。\nおそらく総力戦になるでし: The number of shadows has increased, and the enemy's troops are swelling. It looks like it'll be a total war.
m920025.待て。\nその村に行ってなにをする気だ？:
Wait.
What do you intend to do when you get to that village?
m920025.復讐にかられた者は、\n周りが見えなくなってしまうのは\n良く知っている……。: I know all too well how those driven by revenge lose sight of everything around them...
