m920099.おぬしが眠っておるうちに、わらわは\nおぬしの軍の者たちが復元してくれた宝貝を用: While you slept, I used the treasure the army restored to me to undo the seductive spell I'd cast.
m920099.お～い、王子～っ！\nわらわはもう大丈夫じゃぞ～っ！\n王子も早くこっちに来るの: Hey, Prince! I'm fine now! Come over here quickly, Prince!
m920099.く、ふふ……強いのう。\nそれでこそ、わらわの王子じゃ。: Heh… strong, aren't you? That's exactly the kind of Prince I want.
m920099.くっ……いつの間にあんな遠くに！: Damn… How did she get so far away?
m920099.くっ……せっかく操った妖虎仙を。\nキミたち、本当に邪魔ばかりしてくれるネェ！:
Damn… after finally controlling Youkosen.
You all really love getting in the way!
m920099.くっ……背に腹は代えられぬ。\n王子、すまぬがもう少しだけ一緒に逃げてたもれ！: Damn… I can't trade my back for my belly. Prince, I'm sorry, but stay with me a little longer while we escape!
m920099.くっ、なんていう豪雨……これが皇天君の真の力か。\nみんな、気をつけてくれ！ 陣: Ugh, what a downpour… Is this the Imperial Heavenly Lord's true power? Everyone, watch out! His attack power should be rising on the battlefield!
m920099.くははっ、それもそうじゃのぅ！\nでは、力ずくで頂くとしよう――！: Heh, that's one way to look at it! Then I'll just take him by force—!
m920099.くははははっ！ 無駄じゃ無駄じゃ！\n王子はすでに、わらわの誘惑の術に\nかかっ: Hahaha! Futile, futile! The Prince is already caught in my temptation technique!
m920099.くふふ……よいぞ、どんどん行くのじゃ！\n見事王子を捕らえた者には、\nわらわが: Heh heh… That's it, keep coming at me! Whoever manages to capture the Prince will be treated to my special cooking!
m920099.くふふ、こう見えてわらわは家庭的なのじゃぞ？\nおぬしのためにこれから毎朝\n美:
Heh heh, don't let this appearance fool you—I'm quite the homebody.
From now on I'll make you a delicious porridge every morning—
m920099.くふふ。術をかけたこの宝貝で解除の術を施さねば、\n王子にかけた誘惑の術は死ぬま: Heh heh. Unless I use this gem to cast the undoing spell, the temptation I placed on the Prince will never break, even in death.
m920099.くふふっ！ そうかそうか、一人もおらぬか！\nでは、王子は頂いていくぞ？ くふふ: Heh heh! I see, I see, no one left! Then I'll take the Prince away! Heh heh, hahahaha!
m920099.ぐ……ゥ……アン、ナ……逃げ、ろ……ッ！\nお、おまえ、を……拘、束……したく…: G… ugh… An…na… run…! Y-you… don't… want… to… restrain… me…! …ugh… uaaa…!!
m920099.ぐふッ……ぬ、抜かったか……。\n……仕方あるまい。ここは一時撤退だ。: Guh… you got away… …Fine, we have no choice. We'll retreat for now.
m920099.げっ！？\nあの野郎、妖怪どもをけしかけてきやがったぞ！:
Ugh!?
That bastard is inciting the youkai!
m920099.ここならそうそう見つかることもあるまい。\nさぁ……これより夫婦の契りを交わし、:
Here we won't be discovered easily.
Now… let's exchange vows as husband and wife,
and nurture our freshly-born love together♪
m920099.ここまでだな、堕姫。: This is as far as it goes, Daki.
m920099.この雨は――妖術か！\nひょっとして、キミが音に聞く皇天君かい？: This rain—it's sorcery! Could it be you, the Imperial Heavenly Lord I've heard about?
m920099.この黒き翼は、一瞬でも神のご意志を疑った\n不遜な私への戒めの証……。\nですが:
These black wings are a token of punishment for my arrogance, for ever doubting God's will…
But I have no doubt any longer.
m920099.これは思わぬ収穫かもしれん。\nこの手の術はあまり得意な方ではないからな。:
This might be an unexpected bounty.
I'm not particularly skilled with this kind of technique.
m920099.さぁ……どうする堕姫ちゃん？\nアチキに従い、最愛の王子と共に暮らすか。\nアチ: So… what will it be, Daki-chan? Follow me and live with your beloved Prince, or betray me and meet a traitor's end.
m920099.さぁ、戦きながら逝きなさい。\nこの銃が滅びの旋律を奏でる時です。:
Now, go forth and meet your end in battle.
This is the moment when this gun plays the melody of ruin.
m920099.さぁて、話は終わりじゃ。\nゆけ、獣ども！ わらわと王子の愛を邪魔する\n目障り: Well then, that's that. Go, beasts! Scatter those meddling humans who dare to interfere with my love for the Prince!
m920099.さぁ堕姫ちゃん、王子と共に戦いなさい！\nさもなければ二度と王子に会えなくなるわ: Come on, Daki, fight alongside the Prince! Otherwise you'll never see him again, got it?
m920099.さすがに強者は引き際を知る……ってところか。: A true strong one knows when to retreat… I guess.
m920099.さて、そろそろまたあの女狐を探しに行くか。\n……まあ、こちらに来ていないという: Now then, shall we go hunt that fox again? …Well, since she hasn't shown up here, she's probably already been caught by “that guy” by now.
m920099.さて、術の力を結晶化するには\n核となるのに適した物質が必要だ。\nその物質とし: To crystallize magical power, you need a core material that's suitable. She chose the red spider lily for that.
m920099.さほど強力ではないとはいえ、\nあの彼岸花には誘惑の術の効果が乗り移っておる。\:
They're not that powerful, but those spider lilies still carry the lingering effect of the temptation spell.
Before the evil sages abuse them, I have to recover what I can….
m920099.じゃから……、\nこれからもず～っと、傍にいさせてたもれ……。: So… please let me stay by your side forever…
m920099.じゃが、おぬしらを見て思い知らされたわ。\n術で無理やり誘惑したところで、\n本: Well, seeing you all has taught me something. No matter how I forcefully tempt you with magic, it can never match a true bond…
m920099.じゃが、ここまでくればもう安心じゃ。\nここなら身を隠す場所はいくらでも――: But now that we're here, you can finally relax. There are plenty of places to hide around here—
m920099.そ……それではナタクさんは\n王子が元通りになる方法をご存知なのですか！？: So… does that mean you know a way to restore the Prince to his original state?!
m920099.そう言われて\nおとなしく王子を渡すとでも思いますか？: Do you really think they'll just hand the prince over obediently just because you say so?
m920099.そのためには……うん、そうだね。\n堕姫が壊した宝貝の欠片を集めて、\nそれを元: For that, yeah, that's right. We need to gather the fragments of the treasure shell Daki shattered and restore it to its original form.
m920099.その宝貝を壊した今、\n王子は永久にわらわのものじゃ！\nのう、王子？: Now that the gem's broken, the Prince will belong to me forever! Right, Prince?
m920099.それで華の国の仙人であるぼくに\n解決策を聞きにきたってわけだ。\nうん、なかな: So you came to me, the immortal of the Flower Kingdom, for a solution. Yeah, that's a wise decision.
m920099.それに、ぼくたちの目的は\nあくまで王子を連れ戻すことだろう？\nあんな奴に構っ: Besides, our goal is to bring the Prince back, right? We shouldn't be fussing with that guy.
m920099.それにしても、あの一目連さん……いえ、\n東天君も堕姫さんと王子を探していたよう: Still, that Ichimoku-ren… I mean, East Sky Lord was also searching for the Fallen Princess and the Prince.
m920099.そんな……アンナさんの制止を振り切って\n堕姫のもとへ行ってしまうなんて……。: That… you'd ignore Anna's warning and run straight to Daki…
m920099.そんな……兵たちが反乱を起こすなんて。\n一体なにが起こっているのでしょうか？: No… soldiers rebelling? What on earth is happening?
m920099.そんな……王子が私たちの敵になるなんて。: I can't believe… the Prince has become our enemy.
m920099.だ、騙されぬぞ！\nおぬしらは邪仙郷で王子を拷問し、\n情報を得た後に殺めるつも: I won't be fooled! You're torturing the Prince in Jasenkyō, then planning to kill him once you get the info, aren't you?
m920099.だから、長である王子を部下にさらわせた。\n貴様らの軍の士気を削ぐためにな。:
So we let the Prince, the commander, be taken by our subordinates.
To sap the morale of your army.
m920099.だが、一度術をかけてしまえば\nもうこんなものは不要じゃ！: But once the spell's cast, I don't need anything else!
m920099.だが、王子たちや皆に迷惑をかけたのは\nわらわたちの方のようだ。\nすまんのぅ。:
But it seems we were the ones causing trouble for the Prince and everyone.
I'm sorry. I was out of my mind.
m920099.っていうより、浮いてるから\n山道でも関係ないんでしょうね。\nはぁ……仙人って: More like, she's floating, so the mountain path doesn't even matter to her. Sigh… I wish I were a hermit.
m920099.っと、誰か来たようだ……ん、あれは……？: Hmm, someone seems to have arrived… huh, what's that…?
m920099.で、王子を追ってくるであろうぼくたちを\n華の国までおびき寄せることにも成功した: So we've managed to lure you, who'll be chasing the Prince, all the way to the Land of Flowers.
m920099.ですが、まだ王子にかけられた術は解けていません。\nひとまず帰還いたしましょう。:
But the spell placed on the Prince hasn't been broken yet.
Let's return for now.
Daki-san, you'll come with us too, right?
m920099.ですが、王子の奪還に成功したところで\n誘惑の術が解けなければ元も子もありません: But even if we rescue the Prince, it won't mean anything unless we break the enchantment.
m920099.ですが、臆してはいられません。\n邪仙郷に連れ去られる前に王子を奪還しなくては。: Still, we can't afford to hesitate. We have to rescue the Prince before he's taken to Jasenkyō.
m920099.でへへ……任してくだせえ、姐御！: Heh heh… Leave it to me, sis!
m920099.でも殺すのも勿体ないから、\n王子は生かしたまま堕姫ちゃんに進呈するわ。: But killing him would be a waste, so we'll keep him alive and hand him over to you, Daki.
m920099.とにかく応戦しましょう。\n皆さん、戦闘の準備をしてください。:
Anyway, let's fight back.
Everyone, prepare for battle.
m920099.どうした？ 他に王子を止められる者はおらぬのか？\n止めなければ王子はわらわと共: What's the matter? No one else can stop the Prince? If you don't, he'll leave with me.
m920099.どわっ！？\nや、野郎……飛んでいきやがった！: What the—!? You… you flew away!
m920099.な……何故じゃ？\nわらわは……おぬしを捕らえて\n邪仙郷へ連れ去ろうとしたのじ: Wh… why? I was going to capture you and take you to Jasen Village, you know?
m920099.なかなかいい計画だが、重大な欠陥があるな。\nそれは、てめえじゃ俺たちには勝てね: Not a bad plan, but it has a serious flaw. You can't beat us.
m920099.なにがデートだ！ 無理やりさらったくせに！\nさぁ、王子は返してもらうぞ！: What date! You kidnapped him! Hand the Prince over right now!
m920099.なにが姐御だ！ そこをどけ！\n堕姫様の手料理は俺のものだ！: What are you calling me “sis” for? Move aside! Daki's cooking belongs to me!
m920099.なら今度こそ懲らしめてあげなくては。\n王子、兵たちを正気に戻すためにも、\nひ: Then we'll have to teach her a lesson this time. Prince, we need to drive those soldiers back to their senses, so let's fight back for now.
m920099.なるほど……誘惑の術ですか。\nまた王子を捕らえに来るなんて、\nあの人も懲りま: I see… a temptation technique. She keeps coming back for the Prince, and that fool never learns.
m920099.なッ……宝貝を壊した！？: Wh-… you broke the treasured gem!?
m920099.はぁ、はぁっ……苦労をかけてすまんのぅ、王子。\nわらわがおぬしをさらって逃げた: Haa… haa… I'm sorry for the trouble, Prince. It's my fault you were snatched away…
m920099.はい……王子が邪仙の手先に連れ去られるなんて。\n正直、もうどうしたらいいのやら: Yes… the Prince being taken by Jasen's minions. Honestly, I don't know what to do anymore…
m920099.はわわ……こ、怖かったのじゃ……。\nすまぬ、皆の衆……。\nわらわ、助けてもら:
Hah… it was scary…
I'm sorry, everyone…
I keep getting rescued…
m920099.ば……馬鹿な。\n魔物はともかく、道士たちまでもが\nかくも容易く倒されるとは…: No… how foolish. Even the Taoists fell so easily, let alone the monsters…
m920099.ひぃッ！？ その声は――妖天君！\nそれに、隣におるのは屍解仙か！\nまさか、わ:
Hii! That voice…—Yotenkun!
And next to you is Shikai-sen!?
You're here to finish me off…?
m920099.ひがむな、王国の者たちよ。\n貴様らと違い、我々はいわば他国からの来客。\n国の:
Do not be upset, people of the kingdom.
Unlike you, we are, so to speak, visitors from another country.
It is only natural that we, as guests of the Prince, the nation's ruler, demand generous treatment, right?
m920099.ふぅ……それを聞いて安心した。\n今日の王子がやけに魅力的に見えたのは、\nその:
Phew… hearing that puts me at ease.
The Prince looked unusually charming today—must've been that red spider lily, huh?
m920099.ふぅん……斥候たちの報告で聞いてたけど、\n貴方、そこの彼――王子にゾッコンみた: Hm… I heard it from the scouts. You seem… head-over-heels for that Prince♪ …What do you say—don't you want to live with him?
m920099.ふふっ。堕姫さん、なんだか嬉しそうですね。\nそれでは、帰還いたしましょう。:
Hehe. Daki, you seem delighted.
Then, let's head back.
m920099.ふむ……ひとまずはこんなものだろう。: Hmm… that'll have to do for now.
m920099.ふん、獣人ごときと一緒にするでない。\nわらわは堕姫。華の国は邪仙郷より、\n王: Hmph, don't lump me together with mere beast-people. I am Daki. I am the fox spirit sent from the Land of Flowers, under orders from the Evil Immortal Village to capture the prince.
m920099.へぇ……あれが噂の王子軍御一行様ってワケね。\nウフフッ、思ったより美男美女揃い: Hmm… so that's the famed Prince's entourage you've heard about. Hehe, quite the handsome bunch, isn't it? Still, I can't have them snatch the Prince back.
m920099.ほ、報告！\n魔物に混じって人間の兵が攻めてきます！\n先日行方不明になった兵た: Report! Monsters and human soldiers are attacking together! They look like the troops that went missing recently!
m920099.まぁ、いいサ……無駄に戦力を費やすのは\n通天教主様の望むところじゃないだろうし: Well, fine… wasting troops isn't what the High Priest of the Heavens wants, so we'll withdraw for today.
m920099.まぁ、そう焦らずに聞いてよ。\n王子にかけられた術を解くためには、\n術をかけた: Well, don't be so impatient. To undo the spell placed on the Prince, you have to use the same treasure shell that was used to cast it, and perform a reversal spell.
m920099.まったく……いけ好かない子ねぇ。: Good grief… what a detestable child.
m920099.まったく……王子は甘すぎです。\nこの方は貴方を誘拐しようとしたのですよ？: Honestly… the Prince is too naive. She was trying to abduct you, you know?
m920099.まったくだぜ。\n危険なことは判ってんのに、\nどうして一人でこんなところまで来:
Exactly.
You know it's dangerous, yet you came here alone!
m920099.もうじき華の国だ。\n堕姫と王子も近くにいるはずだよ。\nみんな、山道続きで疲れ: We'll be at the Land of Flowers soon. Daki and the Prince should be nearby. Everyone, are you all tired from the mountain trail?
m920099.もうっ！ どうして邪魔するの？\nせっかく王子と一緒に食べようと思って\n美味し: Enough! Why are you getting in the way? I was just about to pick some delicious apples to eat with the Prince!
m920099.やぁねぇ、堕姫ちゃん。\nそう毛を逆立てなくても大丈夫よぉ。\nアチキは貴方たち: Hey there, Daki-chan. No need to get all ruffled. I'm on your side, you know♪
m920099.ゆ、ユリアンさん、落ち着いてください。\n……って、あら？ 堕姫さんは？: Julian, calm down… Wait, what? Daki?
m920099.よかった、間に合ったようですね。\n堕姫さんが一人で華の国へ向かったという\n噂:
Thank goodness—looks like we made it in time.
When we heard the rumor that Daki went alone to the Land of Flowers, we rushed here, and it paid off.
m920099.わわっ！？ こ、こっちに来たぞ！\nっていうかヤツら、普段より興奮してないか？: Wah! It's coming this way! …But aren't they more excited than usual?
m920099.んなッ……あ、赤くなどなっておらんわ！\n気安く触れるでない、このっ……痴れ者め: Huh… I-am not red at all! Don't touch me so casually, you… fool!
m920099.んむっ！？ おぬしら、何故ここに！？: Hmph!? Who are you, appearing here?!
m920099.アチキもそろそろ向かうとするわ。\nそれじゃ、アデュー！: I'll be heading over there myself. Until then, adieu!
m920099.アハハッ、ご明察よぉん！\nアチキは華の国の仙人、十天君が一人の皇天君。\nこの: Ahaha, you're spot on! I'm the sage of the Flower Nation, the Ten-Heaven Lord, a lone Imperial Heavenly Lord. This rain is my prized treasure, summoned by the Kousui Formation.
m920099.ウフフ……安心して。傷つけたりはしないわ。\n王子と彼の軍を分断できた時点で、\: Hehe… don't worry. We won't hurt him. Once we've split the Prince from his army, our goal is essentially achieved.
m920099.ウフフ……貴方がアチキの言うことに従って\n邪仙郷に王子を連れて行くって約束する: Hehe… if you agree to take the Prince to Jasenkyō as I asked, I'll make it happen for you—just you wait♪
m920099.ウフフ……選択肢があるとでも思ってるの？\n王子を連れてアチキたち十天君から逃げ: Hehe… Do you really think you have a choice? Escaping with the Prince from the Ten Heavenly Lords is something you can't possibly pull off.
m920099.カッカッカ……なにを驚いておる？\nぬしのように邪仙郷の掟に背いた者が\n粛清さ:
Kakkakka… what are you so surprised about?
Anyone who, like you, defies the rules of Evil Sage Village
is bound to be purged, isn't it?
m920099.キミにはボクたちの面子を随分潰されたからネェ。\n裏切り者に相応しい凄惨な死を迎:
You've already crushed our reputation quite a bit.
Now I'll give you a gruesously fitting death for a traitor!
m920099.ゼエッ、ゼエッ……。\nクソッ……あの女、なんつー体力だ。: Huh… Huh… Damn… That woman's stamina is insane.
m920099.チャンスよ！\n堕姫ちゃん、駆け寄ってきたその女を\n人質に取るよう王子に命じな: This is your chance! Daki, order the Prince to take that woman who rushed over as a hostage!
m920099.ナタクさんの仰る通りです。\n引き続き王子と堕姫さんの行方を追いつつ、\n術を解: Exactly as Nataku-san says. We'll keep tracking the Prince and the Fallen Princess, and gather the red spider lilies we need to break the spell.
m920099.ヌハハッ、馬鹿め！\n王子のいない貴様らの軍など恐るるに足らんわ！: Nuhaha, you fool! An army without the Prince is nothing to fear!
m920099.バシラ～っ！\n私たちもデートしましょ～っ♪: Bashira~! Let's go on a date too~♪
m920099.ホホっ、いい返事だネェ！\nそれじゃあ、そろそろ登場してもらうとしヨウ。\n邪仙:
Hoho, that's a good answer!
Well then, let's have him make his entrance.
To that man they called the heretic of Evil Sage Village—hoho!
m920099.三人……？\n妖天君と屍解仙の他に誰かいるというのでしょうか？: Three…? Besides Yotenkun and Shikai-sen, is there someone else?
m920099.二度と会わぬと誓うこと。それが一番の罪滅ぼしじゃ。\nさらばじゃ、王子……こんな: Swearing never to meet again—that's the greatest atonement. Farewell, Prince… I may not have the right to say this, but I was happy spending time with you…
m920099.人質としてなにかの交渉に使えるかもだしねぇ。\nフフッ、そうなるまでは邪仙郷で\: He could serve as a hostage for negotiations. Until then, we'll let you live together in Jasenkyō.
m920099.今は地道に赤い彼岸花を集めながら機会を窺おう。\n王子を助け出すための好機は、じ: For now, let's quietly gather those red spider lilies and bide our time. The chance to rescue the Prince will come soon enough.
m920099.今回ばかりは仕方ありません。\n皆さんは赤い彼岸花に秘められた\n誘惑の力の影響:
This time there's no helping it.
Everyone was under the influence of the seductive power sealed in that red spider lily.
m920099.今日のところは一旦退きましょう。\n私が銃の引き金を引けなかった、\nその理由を:
For now, let's withdraw.
I need to find out why I couldn't pull the trigger.
m920099.仙術――中でも浮遊術を修めた道士たちは\n地形に囚われることなく移動してきます。: Their sorcery—especially the floating technique—lets them move without being bound by terrain. Keep a close eye on their movements.
m920099.何十回、何百回……いや何千回だったかしらねぇ？\n貴方が邪仙郷からの逃亡を図り、: How many times… tens? Hundreds? No, maybe thousands? You've tried to flee Jasenkyō over and over and kept failing. Heh… I wonder if it's already gone? The rope scar I carved on your neck the other day.
m920099.先に術者をどうにかした方がよさそうですね。\n王子、ご指示をお願いします。: We should deal with the caster first. Prince, please give us orders.
m920099.全く……目障りな奴らだネェ。\nそんなに死んじゃいたいなら、\n邪仙郷有数の術者:
Honestly… you're such a nuisance.

m920207.私は私にできる方法で企業を守るのみ。\nそれが、魔界ズビジネスマンの鋼の忠誠！:
I am merely protecting the company in the way I can.
That is the steel-strong loyalty of a true Demon World businessman!
m920207.空から発見！ 見つけましたよデモシェフ商会！\nいえ、インテリデーモン！:
Spotted from the air! I've found the Demoshop Trading Company!
No, the Intelligent Demon!
m920207.素晴らしい。全員揃っていますね。\nメンバー的にも今年のクリスマスは安心できそう:
Wonderful. Everyone is here. 
With this lineup, this year's Christmas should be in safe hands.
m920207.結局オルカ科学ラボの皆様には、\n勘違いで申し訳ないことをしてしまいましたわ……:
In the end, we were mistaken about the Orca Science Lab.
I'm terribly sorry for the misunderstanding...
m920207.罰金刑代わりの奉仕活動だから、\n無償労働になって悔しい顔してるかも。\nぁあー:
It's community service in lieu of a fine, so
they're probably grumbling about the unpaid labor.
Aaah, the thought of no pay is unbearable!
m920207.聖前夜を騒がす科学の悪徒たち！: You villains of science, disturbing the holy night!

Receive this punishment for insulting the Holy Night, Manmon Cult!
Let's go!

Just as we heard, they're handing out toys.

they look just like the ones the peddler brought in.
m920207.色々……本当に色々なことがありましたが、\n無事、役目を全うすることができ、一安:
There were…… so many things that happened,

m920207.行商人様のお荷物がそこら中に……。: The merchant's cargo is scattered all over the place...
m920207.街にてシャチのギルマンが\nプレゼント配りをしているとのことです！:
It seems Gilman the Orca is 
distributing presents in the town!
m920207.見過ごすわけにはいかないわ。\nさーて、洗いざらい吐いてもらいましょうか。:
We can't just let this slide. 
Let's get them to spill everything.
m920207.解っている。我らの売り上げの為、\n働きかけてくれたのだろう。:
I understand. You were acting to boost our sales,
were you not?
m920207.解りましたわ。\n行商人様をお守りしつつ戦いましょう！:
Understood. 
Let's protect the merchant while we fight!
m920207.話は聞いたよ。あんたたち、南へ行くんだろう。\n私たちの船を使いなよ。:
We heard the news. You're heading south, aren't you?
Use our ship.
m920207.貴方がたは忘れているようですが、\n私の手には、既に生産された改造おもちゃがあり:
It seems you've forgotten, but
I already have a stock of the modified toys!
m920207.鋼の都に住み着いたあのデーモン。\nやはり彼奴に協力を要請すべきだったか……！:
That demon living in the Steel City……
I should have sought his cooperation after all……!
m920207.頼もしい仲間も増えましたことですし、\n早速南国新工場へと向かいましょう！:
With such reliable allies by our side,
let's head straight for the new tropical factory!
m920207.馬鹿な……私の計画は完璧だったはず……: Ridiculous…… My plan was supposed to be flawless……
m920207.魔物は全部倒し終えたわ！ みんな無事！？: The monsters are all down! Is everyone okay?
m920207.魔獣たちも準備万端！ いつでも繰り出せるわよ。: The beastlings are ready to go! We can deploy at any moment.

Since we're having a victory parade,
we might as well do it the Imperial way.

Tram-sama has settled the battle

m920230.……こうやって誘われては、断れませんね。: ...When invited so directly, I can't refuse.

...If you keep stoking the fire like that,

……Katie, Bernice!
Do I look completely out of place here!?
m920230.あぁ、アーニャ様たちが楽し気にしてイル……。\nなんト尊いことだろうカ……。:
Ah, seeing Princess Anya and the others
so happy...
How noble...
m920230.あぁぁ～～マッサージきもちぃ～～～……。: Ahhh~~~ that massage feels so good~~~……
m920230.あぁそれと……帝国の復興は進んでいるようだな。: Ah, and it seems the Empire is recovering well.

Oh, rather than explaining, why don't you just experience it?
A tea party, princess style.
m920230.あたしだけ名前が知られてないの！？\n自分から経歴隠してたけど！\n讃えられない:
Only my name is unknown?!
I was the one who hid my background!
It's complicated that I'm not being praised!!
m920230.あっ、いけません。\n頑張るなんて口にしたら……。:
Ah, that was careless.

m920230.あなたの記録って、\n本当に後世に伝わっていないのですね……。:
Your records...
they truly haven't been passed down to later generations...
m920230.あのー、菓子折りじゃないですけど、\n裁縫道具とかって売ってたりします？\nさっ:
Um, it's not sweets, but
do you sell any sewing kits?
My fancy dress got a hole in it during that gunfight...
m920230.あの笑顔はやべぇ！ 俺たちも殺される！\nだからどれくらい強いか手合わせ願うね。:
That smile is scary! We're next!

m920230.あー……さぁね？ もう忘れちゃったよ。:
Ah... well, I don't remember.

No, I've had enough.

Woah!! Tram-sama! Solais-sama!

m920230.うわぁっ！ なんだこの妖怪！？: Whoa! What kind of monster is that!?
m920230.え、笑顔は、素敵じゃねぇか……！！: Wait, that smile is... actually pretty nice...!!
m920230.えぇ、そうね。\nとても楽しいお茶会だわ。:
Yes, it is.
It's been a very enjoyable tea party.

Yes, there are areas where our hands are tied.

Huh, what?!

H-hey! You're still the same hopeless one!

Hey, hey, please don't!

Ohh! Having Katie and Bernice on my side is such a relief!

m920230.おぉっ！ 貴方ハもしや、トリシャさんですか！: Oh! Could it be... Ms. Trisha?
m920230.おお、歓迎会の甲斐あってか、\n名前を覚えてもらえたみたいですね。:
Oh, it seems the welcome party paid off.

Being a princess must involve a lot of thinking……

getting along with others is a good thing!
m920230.お茶を楽しむだけじゃなくて、戦いも楽しむの。\nつまりは、模擬戦をするってことね:
It's not just about enjoying the tea; it's about enjoying the battle too.
In other words, we hold a sparring match.
m920230.こう、繋がりがたくさんあってすごいなぁ、って思って！: It's amazing how many connections there are here.

This place is full of guys like that,
so you two should just relax too.

Around this time of year…… that monster always gets a strange burst of energy……

As expected of a strategist, you catch on quickly.

Since we're here, Katie and Bernice,

That's right!

I see. Then I'll join Dina and

Really? I heard you weren't afraid to challenge

Then, let's shoulder to shoulder in battle once more.

Then, do you get excited

Besides, with the matter of that Black Crown,

In that case, I have something perfect.

So please don't be so nervous.

But are you sure it's safe?

Oh, by the way, there's something I've been curious about.

I'm so overwhelmed I'm practically trembling with nerves!
m920230.なんだこの町！？\n治安が悪いどころじゃないですよ！？:
What is this town!?
This is more than just bad public order!?

I was planning to have a leisurely cup of tea and head home,

Yes. The preparations are likely to be quite a burden,

Hello, Minister of State!

m920230.ふふ、お買い上げありがとうございます。\n今後とも、ご贔屓にしてくださいね。:
Hehe, thank you for your purchase.

m920230.ふふ、商機は見逃せませんから。: Hehe, I can't miss a business opportunity.

m920230.ぷ、プリンセス流のお茶会、ですか……？: A, a tea party, princess style……?

Haa~! You really know a lot!

m920230.べ、別に意図的に記録は残さなかったんだけどね！\n隠居生活をするにはそちらの方が:

I don't know if it's “like us” or not...

First time in the colony, huh?
Just relax. This place is full of guys like that.
m920230.アーニャ様カラ感謝の言葉を貰いましたゾ！？\nこれハもう抑えられナイ！\nパレー:
I received words of gratitude from Lady Anya!?
I can't hold back any longer!
I'm jumping into the parade's sparring match!
m920230.イメージ戦略って大事ですのね……。\nではさっそく……にこっ♪ にぱーっ♪:
So image management is important, I see...
Then, right away... *smile*! *sparkle*!
m920230.イヤハヤ、そう褒められると照れますナ。\n貴方ははじめて見る方ですガ、話上手みた:
Oh my, I blush when you praise me like that.
I haven't seen you before, but you seem like a good conversationalist.
m920230.ジュジュカさん、大丈夫ですか？\nいきなり模擬戦に巻き込まれてましたけど……。:
Jujuka, are you alright?
You got dragged into a sparring match out of nowhere……
m920230.スマン、今のお前たち、チョット気持ち悪いぞ。:
Sorry, but you guys are getting
a little weird right now.
m920230.ハイドースとの戦いも終わって、\n王国も復興の手助けをしてくれているからね。\n:
Now that the war with Hydos is over,
the Kingdom is helping with the reconstruction.
I'm sure our daily lives will return to normal soon.
m920230.ハハハッ！ 荒れた凱旋になったがこいつは重畳だ！\nお二方の力を、すぐ近くで拝見:
Hahahaha! A rough victory parade, huh? That's fine!
I'll get to see your powers up close!!
m920230.パレードでも模擬戦でも実戦でも！\nなんでも誠心誠意、王国の一員としてやっていき:
Whether it's the parade, a sparring match, or real combat!
I'll do everything with sincerity, as a member of the Kingdom!
m920230.パレードの出発地点は開拓地からですね。: The parade starts from the colony, then.
m920230.ヒャァ！ 王国から活きがいいのが来たぞ！\nオメーら銃を抜けェーーッ！！:
Hyaah! A lively one from the kingdom has arrived!
You guys, draw your guns—!!
m920230.ヘカティエ様のため、一位の座は奪わせてもらうぞ！: For Hecatie's sake, I'll take that First Place title!
m920230.一位防衛おめでとう。\nそれで、君はどうする？\nもう少し戦ってみるかい。:
Congratulations on defending First Place.
So, what will you do?
Want to keep fighting?
m920230.人気闘兵の一位は力づくで奪えるものではないのでは……？: I don't think the top spot among popular warriors can be taken by force...
m920230.今、頑張るって言いました？: Did you just say you'd “give it your all”?
m920230.今代の皇帝と、その友たる王子がいるからです。: It is because of the current Emperor, and his friend, the Prince.
m920230.他にも開拓地から天界まで……。\n例年どおり、色んなところを回るんですね。:
And from the Frontier all the way to the Celestial Realm……
It seems you'll be visiting quite a few places, just like every year.
m920230.他国への、表敬訪問ですか……？: A courtesy visit to other nations, is it……?
m920230.働き疲れたらそうするかも。: I might, once I'm tired of working.
m920230.先代武王に初代皇帝、\n他にも数多の強者たちと並ぶと考えると、\n少し緊張してし:
Standing alongside the former Martial King, the First Emperor,
and so many other strong warriors...
I'm a little nervous.
m920230.凱旋パレードで各国をまわるでしょう？\n北の大国の王家を代表する以上、挨拶は必要:
You'll be touring the various countries for the triumphal parade, won't you?
As a representative of the royal house of the Northern Great Power, greetings are a necessity.
m920230.凱旋パレードの終着点にここを選んだのなら、\n最後にひとつ試合で武を競うのはどう:
Since you chose this as the destination for the victory parade,
how about we settle it with one final match?
m920230.初代皇帝と初代帝国騎士団長がいるからか？: Is it because of the First Emperor and the First Imperial Knight Commander?
m920230.別に、それでも構いませんよ。\n誤解していてもらったほうが得なこともありますし。:
Not that it matters.
Sometimes, it's better to be misunderstood.
m920230.前の凱旋パレードのときの……。\nあの冗句、言うんじゃなかったかな……。:
That was during the last victory parade...
I probably shouldn't have made that joke...
m920230.千年前、亜神トラムから、\nクラウ・ソラスを受け継いダ伝説の竜姫！\nあ、アーニ:
The legendary Dragon Princess who inherited Claw Solas
from the Demigod Tram a thousand years ago!
To be able to behold Lady Anya!!
m920230.受賞者全員との乱戦となると面倒だから。\nただ、やる以上は本気でやるよ。\n白の:
A free-for-all with all the winners would be a hassle.
But since I'm doing it, I'll do it seriously.
As the White Empire's representative of martial strength, I'll go all out.
m920230.堅苦しいのは苦手だしさ。\nそれに友だちと一緒にいたほうが楽しいだろ？:
I'm not a fan of stiff formalities.
Besides, it's more fun when you're with friends, right?
m920230.大丈夫かー？\nなんだったら私がマッサージするぞ！:
You okay?
If you want, I can give you a massage!
m920230.尊い……可愛い……。\nあの空間、絶対いい匂いする……。:
Noble... cute...
That space must smell amazing...
m920230.山の一部を吹き飛ばしタリ、\n異世界召喚士と組んで魔神を姪っ子にシタ話は、\nこ:
The story of how you blew away part of a mountain,
and teamed up with a summoner from another world to make a demon god your niece,
has even reached this village!
m920230.市民が挑むのは無謀すぎるだろう。: It's far too reckless for a citizen to challenge her.
m920230.当初の予定通り、のんびりお茶でもして、\nヘカティエ様のもとに帰るとしよう。: As planned, I'll have a leisurely cup of tea before heading back to Hecatie.
m920230.後日菓子折りが届くと思うから、\nそれで手打ちにしてやってくれよなァ。:
I think a box of sweets will show up eventually,
so just accept that as a peace offering, okay?
m920230.戦場のイーファさんは結構怖いですよ？ 歴戦って感じで。: Yipha on the battlefield is pretty scary, you know? She gives off a seasoned veteran vibe.
m920230.新参者の私でも勝てさえすれば一位ってマジですか！\nうぉぉ！！ 漲ってきましたー:
Even a newcomer like me can get First Place if I win?!
Woah!! My blood is boiling!!
m920230.王国古参のふたりは、\nどっちかっていうと借りられる側な気がしますけどね！:
The two veteran Kingdom warriors
seem more like the ones who should be borrowing confidence!
m920230.皆、気合は十分といったところか。\nせっかくなら、そこの二人も一緒にどうじゃ？:
Everyone seems fully prepared.
Since we're at it, how about those two join in?
m920230.私たちは安心して、今の帝国を見守るだけですよ。:
We simply watch over the Empire now,
with peace of mind.
m920230.竜人のみんな、すごく喜んでくれてたね。: Everyone was really happy, the dragonkin.
m920230.竜姫アーニャは竜人の間だと有名人だからね。\n手合わせできるとなったら、\nこう:
Dragon Princess Anya is quite famous among the dragonkin.
It's only natural that things would get this heated
when the chance to spar with her comes up.
m920230.糸は出せても針がなきゃ無理ですよー！: I can produce thread, but I can't do it without a needle!
m920230.糸使いのようですが、\nその糸で穴を縫うことはできないのですか？:
It seems you use thread,
can't you sew the hole with that?
m920230.胸を借りる気持ちで、飛び込んでいきましょう！: Let's dive in with the mindset of just borrowing some confidence!
m920230.興奮とは違うが、柄にもなく緊張することはあるよ。\n初めて会ったときは翼が伸びる:
It's not quite excitement, but I do find myself
nervous on occasion, which is unusual for me.
When I first met her, I felt like my wings were sprouting.
m920230.菓子折りですか……。\nちょうど最近仕入れていたので、\nお求めの方がいれば今す:
A box of sweets, you say...
I just stocked up on some, so
I can prepare one right now if anyone wants to buy.
m920230.華の国最強の証明たる『武王』の称号を持つ者。\n正真正銘の偉人にして強者が相手と:
The one who holds the title of "Martial King," proof of the strongest in the Land of Flowers.
Facing a true great man and warrior makes my heart race.
m920230.装備を新調したのだろう？\nであれば試してみたいとは思わんか。:
You've got new equipment, haven't you?
Don't you want to test it out?
m920230.言ってイイことと……悪いコトがありますゾ……！:
There are things that are okay to say...
and things that are not...!
m920230.迷惑かけて悪かったな。\n後で詫びを入れるように言っておくぜェ。:
Sorry for the trouble.
I'll have them apologize properly later.
m920230.隊商として旅をしてきたけど、\nこういった雰囲気は久々ですね。:
I've traveled with caravans before,
but it's been a while since I've felt an atmosphere like this.
m920230.（ふむ、装いが新しくなっているからな。\nそれでいつも以上に気合が入っているのだ:
(Hmm, their attire is new.
That must be why they're more fired up than usual.)
m920230.（今日の二人は、なんだか優しいというか、\n妙に張り切っているような気がしますね:
(The two of them seem unusually gentle today,
or perhaps just a bit too eager, if you ask me.)

m940012.――『この身の破滅を』、か。\n俺が留守の間に、ずいぶんと物騒な客が来たものだ。:
――“The destruction of this body,” huh.
While I'm away, you've certainly attracted some dangerous company.
m940012.――あ、お話、終わった？\n王子たち、出発の準備ができたって。:
—Ah, is the discussion over?
The Prince and his party are ready to depart.
m940012.――お待ちなさい。\nその方々は、私がお招きした客人です。:
Wait.
Those people are guests I invited.
m940012.――すみません！ 誰かー！ 助けてほしいっす！\n北の道に、まだ人が残ってて……:
???: —Excuse me! Is anyone there? Please help us!
There are still people left on the northern road...!
m940012.――そうそう。\nお宿はちゃんと取るから、まぁ安心して。\n旅の連れもほら、この:
――Right, right.
I'll make sure we get proper lodging, so don't worry.
Besides, I have travel companions, just as you can see.
m940012.――っすー！\n大変っすー！ 大変なんすよー！！:
--Whew!
This is bad! It's really bad!!
m940012.――では、私は人質ということで。: —Then, I shall serve as the hostage.
m940012.――と、言うと思ったので。: I thought you would say that.
m940012.――ならない。\nああ、分かっているとも、オリジナル。:
???: --no, it is not.
Ah, I understand, Original.
m940012.――ねぇ、大丈夫？\nわっ……すごい汗。ちょっと、絶対休んだほうがいいよ！:
――Hey, are you okay?
Whoa… you're sweating so much. You really should rest!
m940012.――やめて！\nふたりとも、その剣を置いて！:
――Stop!
Both of you, put those swords down!
m940012.――ッ……まったく、\n呪いに蝕まれるのも、難儀なことだ。:
――Tch… Honestly,
being consumed by a curse is no small ordeal.
m940012.――原因は、俺に施された呪いだろう。\nこの呪いから溢れ続ける魔力が、形をなした:
—The cause must be the curse placed on me.
The magic power overflowing from this curse has taken shape.
If that flow of magic power stops, what happens to them?
m940012.――同じ剣技、同じ力……。\n戦い方こそ違えど、その奥底にあるものは同じ。:
――The same swordsmanship, the same power…
Though our fighting styles differ, what lies at the core is identical.
m940012.――女皇陛下！ 影なる希望！\n漆黒の騎士皇帝！ 我らがディアナ様！\n戦うすべ:
――Your Imperial Majesty! The Hope of Shadows!
The Knight Emperor of Darkness! Our Lady Diana!
All those who possess the means to fight are assembled!
m940012.――宣戦布告をしてきたのですよ。\nそれも、勝っても負けても、\nあの女が利益を:
――has issued a declaration of war.
A war where she profits no matter the outcome,
win or lose.
m940012.――待っていろ、タルタロスの神よ。\nこれ以上、俺の民を貴様の試練に使わせん。:
—Wait for me, god of Tantalos.
I will not let you use my people as your trial any longer.
m940012.――戦えない方々を、奥へ。\nあなたの一族も、負傷者はもう下がらせなさい。:
—Move those who cannot fight to the rear.
Your clan as well; have the wounded withdraw.
m940012.――止まれ！\n白の帝国の軍勢が、何用であるか！:
--Halt!
What business does the White Empire's army have here!
m940012.――気に入らない。\n本当に、心底仲良くなれる気はしませんが……。:
—I do not like it.
I truly do not feel we can become close friends, but…
m940012.――陛下。\n敵方に潜んでいた神官を捕らえました。\nただ……敗れたというのに、:
――Your Highness.
We captured a priest who was hiding among the enemy.
But…… despite losing, he kept smiling the whole time.
m940012.…………！\nそうか、さっきの炎……。\nあれはきみの力ではなく、きみを罰してい:
…………!
I see. That flame from earlier…
It wasn't your power, was it? It was a flame punishing you.
m940012.……あなたは……王子、殿下？\n私を、助けるつもりなの？:
……You are… the Prince?
Are you here to save me?
m940012.……うぅん。\nよかったら、連れて行ってくれない……？:
...Mmm.
Could you... take me with you?
m940012.……うわぁ。\n帝都と、そっくりっすね。\n道、間違えそうっす……。:
...Whoa.
It's just like the Imperial Capital.
I almost got lost...
m940012.……ええ。\n帝国が強さを求めたのは、乱世ゆえ。\nしかし平和な世が訪れれば、そ:
…Yes.
The Empire sought strength because it was an age of chaos.
But once peace arrives, that very system becomes a poison.
m940012.……えっ。\nあの、あれ？ どういうことっすか？:
...Huh?
I mean, what? What does that mean?
m940012.……お前の答えは、分かっている。\n私は、その答えを選べなかったものだ。\nそれ:
...I know your answer.
I am the one who could not choose that answer.
Do not make me say more.
m940012.……お待ちを。\nどうか、双方剣をおさめてください。:
…Wait, please.
Please, both of you, sheathe your swords.
m940012.……きみ、もしかしてオリュンポスの関係者だったり？\nいや、でもその顔に見覚えは:
……You, are you perhaps connected to Olympus?
No, but I don't recognize your face at all…
m940012.……そうですか。\nでは、そのお節介には、もう少し付き合います。\n王国まで、よ:
…I see.
Then, I shall indulge your meddling a little longer.
Please, guide us to the kingdom.
m940012.……それで、イクセリス。\n出現した影のディアナは、\n貴様が惑わされたものと、:
……And then, Exelis.
Is the shadow Diana that appeared
created by the same magic that deluded you?
m940012.……っ。\nやはり、私もか……。:
...
So, I am one of them too...
m940012.……っ。\n私と同じ姿の者を見ても、不用意に近づくな。\n各隊にも、そう伝えろ。:
...Tch.
Do not approach anyone who looks like me carelessly.
Convey this order to all squads.
m940012.……でも、困ったわね。\n黒い泥……タルタロスの魔力が、\nもう何日も噴き出して:
...However, this is a problem.
That black mud... the mana of Tartarus
has been erupting for several days, hasn't it?
m940012.……ならば、どうしろと？\n私たちは、オリジナルではない。\nその欲望だけを取り:
……Then what would you have us do?
We are not the originals.
We are fakes, created solely to extract those desires.
m940012.……ならば、まず、その呪いを断つ。\nディアナとレオナが原型ならば、話は通じるだ:
…Then, first, we must sever that curse.
If Diana and Leona are the originals, we should be able to reason with them.
m940012.……ひとり旅の予定だったが、\nなぜ貴様がここにいる。:
...I was planning to travel alone.
Why are you here?
m940012.……まさか、そこですでに、\n私もタルタロスの魔力の影響を受けていたと？\nしか:
...Could it be that I was already under the influence
of Tartarus's power back then?
But that was quite some time ago...
m940012.……まわりくどいことを。: ……What a roundabout way to put it.
m940012.……下がれ、ヘルメルク、ウルスラ。\nこの娘、様子がおかしい。:
……Fall back, Hermerk, Ursula.
This girl is acting strangely.
m940012.……俺が戻れば、呪いを持ち帰ることにもなる。\n向こうの状況が分かるまでは、動き:
...If I return, I'll be carrying the curse back with me.
We can't move until we understand the situation on the other side.
m940012.……俺の人徳によるものではないがな。: ……It's not due to my personal virtue, though.
m940012.……借り物の玉座に陶酔し、\n腑抜けになっているのではないかと思っていましたが。: ???：...I thought you might have gotten soft, drunk on the power of that borrowed throne. It seems your instincts haven't dulled, though.
m940012.……全軍、武器を収めろ。\nこれ以上の戦闘を禁ずる。我らの、負けだ。:
……All units, stand down.
I forbid any further combat. This is our defeat.
m940012.……前世の記憶、だもんね。: ...It's memories from your past life, right?
m940012.……器？\nまさか、神を宿らせるつもり？:
……A vessel?
You intend to house a god within it?
m940012.……大丈夫？ 少し休む？: ...Are you okay? Do you want to rest a bit?
m940012.……女皇陛下。\n我が子らには、あなたを見捨てずに済んだと、\nそう伝えるつもり:
……Your Imperial Majesty.
I returned with the intention of telling my children
that they didn't have to abandon you.
m940012.……帝国幹部だけでも、相当な人数にのぼるのでは？: ...Even just the imperial executives? That's quite a large number, isn't it?
m940012.……死出の旅路、共をしよう。\n冥界でも参謀が必要だろう、我が女皇。:
……Let us walk the path to death together.
The underworld will surely need a strategist, my Empress.
m940012.……民を、守りたかった。\nあの方々が怯えずに暮らせる国を、私が……。:
……I wanted to protect the people.
To create a country where they could live without fear, I…….
m940012.……王子。お願いがあるの。\nこのふたりを、王国に連れていってもらえない？\nそ:
……Prince. I have a request.
Could you take these two to the kingdom?
And then… um, I'd like to come along too.
m940012.……王子か。\nなるほど、そろそろ定期会合の時期だったか。:
……The Prince, is it.
I see, it must be time for our regular meeting.
m940012.……王子に、余計な苦労をかけるな。\n仮にも一国の長だぞ。:
…Do not burden the Prince with unnecessary hardship.
He is the head of a nation, after all.
m940012.……私が、さっき暴れたから……？: ...Could it be... because I caused the commotion earlier...?
m940012.……私が生きて、またあなた方を傷つけたら。\nそれでも、同じことを言えますか？:
……If I live, and hurt you again.
Could you still say the same thing?
m940012.……聞き分けのない方ですね。\nあなた方を守るためには、こうするのが――:
…You are quite stubborn.
To protect you all, this is the only way—
m940012.……試練だと？\n貴様、俺の呪いについて知っているのか。:
……A trial?
You know about my curse?
m940012.……負傷者を送り届けろ。\n戻ったら、私の指示に従え。それでいいな。:
…Send the wounded away.
When you return, follow my instructions. That should be enough.
m940012.……過去のことは、知らん。\nだが俺たちが貴様を傷つけることはない。\nそれに―:
……I know nothing of the past.
But we have no intention of harming you.
Besides—this man defeated the Demigod Zeus.
m940012.……陛下。この者は、私たちが預かります。\n今は、あのおふたりを。:
……Your Majesty. We will take this one into custody.
For now, please attend to those two.
m940012.……陛下が旅立つ前、\n連日、帝国幹部は今後の方針を話し合っていましたね。:
...Before His Majesty set out on his journey,
the Empire's leadership was meeting day after day to discuss our future course of action.
m940012.……騒々しくて仕方ない。\nついてくるなとは言わんが、距離を取れ。\nタルタロス:
...You're so noisy.
I won't tell you to leave, but keep your distance.
We don't know what effects the Curse of Tartarus might have.
m940012.あ、あの……陛下？\nお伺いしたいことが……。:
Um, Your Majesty...
There's something I'd like to ask...
m940012.ああ、ローザ。\nいいえ、借り物の玉座で、\nそんな皇帝の真似事までするつもりは: Ah, Roza. No, I have no intention of playing emperor on a borrowed throne.
m940012.ああ。建前上はな。\n王国で、己のなすべきことを見つめ直すがいい。:
Aye. In name only.
Return to the kingdom and reflect on what you truly ought to do.
m940012.あっ、あたしはチレンっす！\nほんっとーにありがとうございました！:
Oh right, I'm Chiren!
Thank you so much, really!
m940012.あっ、巨人族の連中もいるっす。\nおーい！ そっちも黒い泥に困って――:
Ah, there are some Giants too.
Hey! Are you guys having trouble with the black mud, too--
m940012.あっ、拙の分もお願いします！\nお財布はこちらの陛下護衛用機密費から！:
Oh, please get some for me too!
I'll pay from the Imperial Guard's secret funds!
m940012.あなたたちは、どうなの？\nオリジナルならどうするとかじゃなくて。\nあなたたち:
What about you?
Not what you would do if you were the originals.
Do you really want to die?
m940012.あなたも、同じだと言いたいのですか。\n私の中にあった願いは、\n民を戦わせてで:
Are you saying the same thing?
The wish within me was one that
should be fulfilled, even if it meant making the people fight.
m940012.あの山の向こうにっすね……ほんと、\nこの数ヶ月の間に、突然現れたみたいに――:
It's past that mountain... Seriously,
it just appeared out of nowhere in the last few months, and--
m940012.あれ、おかしいな……。\nレオナさんから、タルタロスの魔力を感じるんですよね。\:
Huh, that's odd...
I can feel the power of Tartarus coming from you, Leona.
I assumed you'd been bitten by that beast earlier...
m940012.あれは……おそらくタルタロスの魔力によって、\n私の欲望から作られたあの女は――: That woman… likely created by Tartarus's mana from my own desires—
m940012.あれもまた、帝国の領土に住まう者だ。\nならば、俺の民に違いない。:
They are also inhabitants of the Empire's territory.
Then, they are my people.
m940012.いいでしょう。\nローザ、サスキア、手を貸してくれますか？: Very well. Roza, Saskia, will you lend me a hand?
m940012.いいや、昔、訪れたことがあるだけだ。\nあの頃は皇帝でも何でもない、ただの旅人だ:
No, I just visited once, a long time ago.
Back then, I was just a traveler. Not an emperor or anything.
m940012.いっそ、このまま帝都に戻った方が早いかもね。: Maybe it would be faster to just head back to the Imperial Capital right now.
m940012.いったい、彼女は何を言っていたのですか？: What on earth was she talking about?
m940012.いや、下がるのは陛下の方では！？: No, the one who should fall back is His Majesty!
m940012.いや、何日か前からっす。\n獣にまとわりついて、それから急に凶暴に……。\n……:
???: No, it's been going on for a few days now.
It clings to the beasts, and then they suddenly turn violent...
...Wait, here they come! Those things!
m940012.うぅん、そうじゃないの。\nディアナさんが、もうひとり増えたわけじゃない。:
No, that's not quite right.
It's not like there's just another Diana.
m940012.うぅん、大丈夫……。\n全部、前世のことだから……。:
No, I'm fine...

It's all from my past life, after all...
m940012.うぇぇぇ！？ 待って！？\nそんな話ぜんぜんしてないっすよ！？:
Wh-What?! Wait!
We never said anything like that!
m940012.うちの里で、変な噂が流れてて……。\nそれで、確認してきたんすよ！:
There's a weird rumor going around our village...
So I went to check it out!
m940012.うん……！\nって、私も道なんて分からないんだけど……。\n王子、案内してくれる:
Y-Yes!
Wait, I don't know the way at all, though…
Prince, will you show us?
m940012.うん。\n前の私は……えーっと……。\nだいぶ見境がないというか、怖いもの知らず:
Yes.

My past self was... um...

Pretty reckless, I guess. Fearless of anything...
m940012.うん。さっき、聞いたよ。\nあの巨人の人、家族と暮らす場所をもらったって。\nあ:
Yeah. I heard that earlier.
That giant person said he was given a place to live with his family.
He said you helped him.
m940012.うん。その前に……\n私がどんな罰を受けたか、話さなきゃ。:
Yes. Before that, though...

I need to tell you what punishment I received.
m940012.うん。願いを鋳型にして、新しい命を生む。\nその人も、そうして生まれたんだと思う:
Yes. A wish is used as a mold to birth new life.
I believe that one was created the same way.
m940012.うんうんっ。\n帝都のお菓子、食べてみたいなぁ♪:
Mm-hmm♪
I'd like to try the sweets from the Imperial Capital♪
m940012.ええ。お待たせしました。\n……あなたには、お礼を言わなければなりませんね。:
Yes. Sorry to keep you waiting.
…There is a debt of gratitude I owe you.
m940012.ええ。勝てば、民の庇護を認めさせる。\n負ければ、首謀者としてすべての責任を負っ:
Yes. If I win, I force her to acknowledge my protection of the people.
If I lose, I bear all the blame as the ringleader,
and in exchange for my life, hand the remaining people over to her.
m940012.ええ。追い払われずに眠れる場所と、明日の食事を。\nまずは、それだけでもと。:
Yes. A place to sleep without being driven away, and food for tomorrow.
That is all I started with.
m940012.えっ。\n……あ、うぅん。そんな……。\n私も、よく分からないまま、必死だっただ:
H-What?
…Ah, no, it's not…
I was just desperately trying to help, without fully understanding the situation.
m940012.えーっと……さてと……。\n怖がられたままだと困るんだけど、\n僕、きみに何かし:
Well… hmm…
It's a problem if you're still scared of me,
but did I do something to you…?
m940012.えーっと、敵ながらお見事、ということでありますか？: E-Excuse me, but as your enemy, I must say… that was quite the display.
m940012.おそらく、ですが……。\n何にせよ、皇帝陛下が旅に出たのは良い判断でした。\n呪:
Probably, yes...
In any case, it was a wise decision for His Majesty to travel.
Curses are things that accumulate over time.
m940012.おっと……この魔力は、もしや……。: Whoa… this magical power… Could it be…
m940012.おやすみの日は昼過ぎまで眠りたいとか、\n王子殿下とおでかけしたいとか――:
Like wanting to sleep until the afternoon on days off,
or wanting to go out with the Prince—
m940012.お前も来るか？\n道案内くらい、できるだろう。:
Are you coming along too?
You can at least handle the directions.
m940012.きみは、ここに残ったほうがいい。\n前世のことは、忘れて生きた方がいいよ。:
You should stay here.
It's better to forget about your past life and live on.
m940012.ここに来てからですね、\n影のおふたりの魔力が、どんどん強くなっているんです。\:
Ever since we arrived,
the shadows' mana has been growing stronger and stronger.
It is likely because you made contact with the Emperor and the originals.
m940012.こちらからも頼めますか。\n影の帝国の民を悪いようにはしません。\nただ、反乱の:
May I make a request as well?
We won't harm the people of the Shadow Empire.
However, we cannot simply let the ringleaders of the rebellion go free.
m940012.こちらも攻撃を止めてください！\n武器を置いた方には、手を出さないで。\n負傷者:
Please, cease your attacks as well!
We will not harm those who lay down their arms.
Let's tend to the wounded immediately!
m940012.このふたりに必要なのは、\n自分が誰なのか、ゆっくり確かめる時間だと思うの。\n:
I think what these two need is
time to slowly figure out who they are.
…Same goes for me.
m940012.このままじゃ、ふたりとも、\nタルタロスの呪いに蝕まれて、\nただの魔物に成り果:
If this continues, both of you
will be consumed by the curse of Tartaros
and reduced to nothing but monsters!
m940012.この取り決めは、俺たちの間だけに留める。\n貴様も、余計な火種を増やすなよ。:
Keep this agreement between us.
And do not add any unnecessary fuel to the fire.
m940012.この周辺一帯で、魔力の乱れが発生しているようで。\nそちらもあわせて調査中、とい:
It seems there's a disturbance in the mana field across this entire area.
We're investigating that as well, if you'll allow me to put it that way.
m940012.この命ひとつによる闘争。\nその先の結末によって、\n「影の帝国」の民をあなたに:
Through this struggle over a single life,
and the outcome that follows,
I will force you to take the people of the “Shadow Empire” under your protection.
m940012.この黒い泥が、生命を持つかのように\nうごめいている理由も、そこに由来するのだろ:
That must be why this black mud
appears to writhe as if it has life.
m940012.これは私たちの責任の取り方です。\nあなたが、気に病むことではありません。:
This is how we take responsibility.
It is not something you should worry about.
m940012.これもある意味では予行演習。\nいつか役に立つ日も来ることでしょう。\n――それ: In a way, this is all practice. It'll come in handy someday. —So, Roza, who is this child?
m940012.こんなところで魔力を撒き散らしたら……。\nウルスラ！ 住人の避難を！\n野生の:
If she unleashes this much power here…
Ursula! Evacuate the villagers!
The wild monsters might start rampaging!
m940012.こんな記憶を取り戻しちゃったら、\nあはは……もう、もとの生活は、ちょっと無理か:
Now that I've regained memories like these,
aha……I don't think I can go back to my old life.
--- scene: Reincarnate of the Snowfield (battle, battle) ---
m940012.さ、サスキアです！\n今はローザさんと一緒に、帝都の警備を！: S-Saskia! I'm currently helping Roza with the Imperial Capital's security!
m940012.さて、残すは首謀者が責任を取るだけ、ですね。: Well, it seems all that remains is for the mastermind to take responsibility.
m940012.し、らない、知らないはずなのに……。\nいやっ……こんなの、\nあなたのことなん:
I… don't know, I shouldn't know…
No… it's impossible,
I shouldn't know you at all…
m940012.しかし、今の白の帝国は違う。\nどこかの誰かさんの、まばゆい輝きに、\n希望を見: But the White Empire of today is different. In the era of that emperor, who found hope in the dazzling brilliance of someone, somewhere.
m940012.すぐに帝都へ連絡を取りましょう。\nまずは、皆さんのご無事を確かめます。:
Let's contact the Imperial Capital right away.
First, we need to confirm everyone's safety.
m940012.すでに皇帝の影が生まれた実例もある。\n早々に旅に出たのはいい判断だったのかもね:
There's already proof that the Emperor's shadow has been born.
Traveling early might have been the right call.
m940012.すべての条件、お受けします。\n皇帝陛下、私の民を、よろしくお願いします。:
I accept all the terms.
Your Majesty, I entrust my people to you.
m940012.そ、そんなふうに言わないでよ……。\nでも、ふたりとも生きててくれて、よかった。:
P-Please don't say it like that…
But I'm glad you're both alive.
I truly mean that.
m940012.そう、それっす！\n里の近くだけじゃなくて、\nここへ来るまで、何か所も噴き出し:
???: Yeah, that's it!
It's not just near the village,
it's been spurting out in several places all the way to here.
m940012.そこまでは、まぁ、納得できるよ。\nついでに情報収集もしようっていうのも分かる。:
I can understand that much.
I also get wanting to gather information while you're at it.
m940012.そのために、家族を守る場所を得た代わりに、\n女皇陛下を見捨ててきたと。\n我が:
And in exchange for gaining a place to protect our families,
we have abandoned Her Imperial Majesty.
Is that what you wish us to tell our children?
m940012.そのどちらも、私には断れないと。\n……実に、気に入りませんね。:
And I cannot refuse either outcome.
…How utterly I dislike this.
m940012.その身に降りかかる呪いを打ち破り、\nより強く、より強靭な器へと至る。\n全ては:
To break the curse that befalls you,
and become a vessel stronger and more resilient.
All of it, to welcome our god…….
m940012.それから、炎の車輪に括られた。\nどれだけ叫んでも、炎は消えなかった。\nいつ終:
Then, I was bound to the wheel of flames.

No matter how much I screamed, the fire wouldn't go out.

I had no idea when it would end...
m940012.それが、タルタロスに囚われた理由ですか。: So that's why you were imprisoned in Tartarus.
m940012.それで、帝都の方は？: So, what about the Imperial Capital?
m940012.それでは、私の帝国でお待ちしています。: Then I shall await you in my empire.
m940012.それに、皇帝が呑気にひとり旅をしていたのも好都合。\nまだ建造途中ではありますが: Besides, it was convenient that the Emperor was off traveling on his own. Even though it's still under construction, we were able to build a Shadow Imperial Capital of this scale.
m940012.そんなの、無理だよ。\n目の前で死のうとしてる人に、\n関係ないから黙ってろなん:
That's impossible.
To tell someone trying to die right in front of you
that it has nothing to do with you and to just shut up……!
m940012.ただ、執務の息抜きに、\n街で食事でも取ろうかと思っただけです。: I just thought I'd take a break from paperwork and grab a meal in town.
m940012.ただの通りすがりはそんな威厳ないっすよ！\nはぁ、それにしても、帝国軍が近くにい:
???: "Merely passing through" doesn't carry that kind of aura!
Phew, I'm so glad we heard the Imperial Army was nearby and came to rely on you.
m940012.ただの魔力なら、確かに霧散するかもしれません。\nですがこれは、呪いの形を取った:
If it were just ordinary magic, it might have dissipated by now.
But this has taken the form of a curse.
m940012.だから、王子に頼まれた旅人の守護神でもある僕と、\n帝国代表でそこのニンジャが来:
That's why I'm here, the guardian deity of the Prince's entrusted traveler,
and the Ninja representing the Empire.
m940012.だからって、護衛をつけないというのは\nさすがにアンジェリーネ様もディアナ様も\:
But not having an escort?
Lady Angelina and Lady Diana
would never allow that.
m940012.だからといって、\n帝都を襲ってよい理由には――:
That is no reason to
attack the Imperial Capital, however--
m940012.だが……肉体の苦痛など、\n一度は国を失った、やつのことを思えば――:
But… physical pain is nothing
compared to the thought of that man,
who once lost his entire country…
m940012.だったら、誰かに止めてもらおうよ。\n私だって暴れちゃったけど、王子も陛下も、\:
Then let someone stop you.
I went on a rampage too, but the Prince and Your Majesty
helped me. And they are still here with me.
m940012.だめっ、間に合わな――: No, we can't make it in ti――
m940012.ちゃんと言葉にしないと伝わりませんわよ？\n王子も、隣で首をかしげてないで。:
You need to say it clearly, or it won't get across!
And you, Prince, stop tilting your head in confusion!
m940012.つまり、あの女が何をするつもりなのか、\n普段の私の行動から推測するのは難しい、:
So, it's difficult to predict what that woman intends to do
based on my usual actions.
m940012.でしたら、やって見せてください。\n弱き者を蹂躙したその力で。:
If so, show us.
With that power which tramples the weak.
m940012.では、こちらは王国と連携し、\nタルタロスの調査を続けておきます。:
Then, we will coordinate with the kingdom
and continue our investigation into Tantalos.
m940012.では、望むなと？\n国のため、立場のため、誰かのため。\nそうして黙っていれば、:
So, you would not wish it?
For the sake of the country, for your position, for someone else.
And if you simply keep silent, you will be rewarded someday?
m940012.では、決着を付けましょう。\nもうひとりの私。:
Then, let us settle this.
My other self.
m940012.でも、あなたたちが死ぬのは嫌なの。\nそう思ったのが、今の私か、昔の私かなんて、:
But I don't want you to die.
Whether that thought comes from the me of now or the me of the past,
it doesn't matter, does it!
m940012.どうやら、民にとってはよき女皇であるようですね。\n少しだけ、安心しました。:
It seems she is a good Empress for her people.
I am a little relieved.
m940012.なぜ貴様は、そう護衛を付けたがる。: Why do you insist on attaching a guard to me?
m940012.ならば、やることは決まったな。: Then, our course of action is decided.
m940012.ならば、殺すものか。\n帝国を改革する良いきっかけだ。\n存分に恨み言を聞いてや:
Then, I will not kill them.
This is a good opportunity to reform the Empire.
I will listen to all their grievances.
m940012.ならば、私が治めればよい。\n何者にも脅かされぬだけの力で、\n私の民を、守り続:
Then, let me rule.
With power that no one can threaten,
I will protect my people, forever—
m940012.なるほど、男女の機微というか、\n強者の余裕というか……難しいものだね。:
I see. The subtleties of romance,
or the composure of the strong… it's a complex matter.
m940012.はぁ……っ、はぁ……。\n来ないで。もう、近づかないで……。:
Haa… haa…
Don't come. Don't get any closer…
m940012.はい。どうやら、囲まれているようです。: Yes. It seems we've been surrounded.
m940012.はいはい、脅さない脅さない。\nそれで、いったい何がどうなったの？:
There, there, I'm not threatening you.

So what happened in the end?
m940012.はいはい。\nあっ、あの屋台いいな……ちょっと買ってこよ。:
Yes, yes.
Ah, that food stall looks good... I'll go buy some.
m940012.はっ、ここで止めておきます！: Hah! I will stop right here!
m940012.はっ、皆よく理解しております。: Yes sir, we all understand perfectly.
m940012.ひとまず早馬を出しました。\nフローガさんに手伝ってもらって、\n魔力通信をしよ:
For now, I've sent out a rider.
I was hoping Floga could help us set up a mana communication link, but—
m940012.ふぅ……剣で片付かない仕事というのも、\nなかなか大変なものですね……。: Phew... Some jobs really can't be solved with a sword. It's quite the ordeal...
m940012.ふぅん、じゃあ今と同じだね。\n白の皇帝ぶらりひとり旅だし。:
I see, so you're the same as now.
Just the White Emperor traveling alone.
m940012.ふたりとも、こちらへ！\nタルタロスの魔力流入を止めます！:
You two, come this way!
We'll stop the inflow of Tantalos's magic power!
m940012.ふふっ、ローザが気に入るなんて。\nこれは将来有望ですね。: Heh, you've taken a liking to her, I see. She has a bright future ahead of her.
m940012.へぇ、侵攻でもしたことあるの？: Huh, did you invade here before?
m940012.まさか……。\nこの帝都に襲撃してくる者が……？: No way... Someone attacking the Imperial Capital?
m940012.また、旅に戻る。\n帝国幹部には既にタルタロスの呪いの影響が\n出たかもしれんが:
I shall return to my journey.
The Empire's senior officers may already be showing signs of Tantalos's curse,
but there is no need to spread the damage any further.
m940012.まっ、多少なりともタルタロスの知識のある人員で、\n交代しながらついていくよ。:
Well, we'll have personnel with some knowledge of Tantalos
rotate in and follow along.
m940012.むっ……待て！\n誰か、剣を取り上げろ！:
Hmph……Wait!
Someone, take the swords away!
m940012.もう命を持っているから、\n魔力の流れを絶っても消えたりしない、けど……。:
Since they already possess life,
cutting off the flow of magic won't make them disappear, but...
m940012.もしかして、皇帝陛下っすか！？\nそっちは……王子殿下！？:
???: Could it be... Your Imperial Majesty?!
And that one is... Your Highness, the Prince?!
m940012.もちろんです。後ろはお任せを。: Of course. Leave our backs to you.
m940012.もー、わかってるでしょ。\n皇帝陛下をひとりで旅なんてさせられないよ。:
Oh, I know, I know.
I can't let His Majesty travel alone.
m940012.やることは決まったって、それって……その……。\n魔力を絶っても殺せないなら、\:
You said our course of action was decided, but that means...
If we can't kill them by cutting off the magic,
does that mean we're going to take them down directly...?
m940012.ようやく得た安住の地を、また手放せというのなら。\n今度こそ、我らは戦う！:
If you would have us give up the only peace we have found.
This time, we will fight!
m940012.よく分からないまま、あれだけ言えたのか。\n大したものだな。:
To speak so boldly without understanding.
That is quite something.
m940012.よく歯向かった、惜しかったな、\n褒美に炎の力を授けてやろう――\nなんて言いそ:
"You resisted well. What a shame.

As a reward, I'll grant you the power of flame"

—That's what he would have said.
m940012.よく知らせてくれた。\nおかげで、民を守ることができた。:
Thank you for the warning.
Thanks to you, we were able to protect the people.
m940012.ん？ ああ、僕？\nどこかで会ったことあったっけ……。:
Hm? Ah, me?
Have we met somewhere before…?
m940012.イクセリス。俺たちは、貴様を罰しに来たのではない。\nだが、タルタロスのことを少:
Ixeris. We are not here to punish you.
But if you know anything about Tartarus,
we would rely on your memory and knowledge. Can you speak?
m940012.タルタロスの魔力を帯びた者。\n帝国に恨みを持つ者、帝国を頼れぬ者……。\nそう:
Those who bear the power of Tartaros.
Those who harbor resentment against the Empire, those who cannot rely on it...
You have taken them in.
m940012.ディアナ、貴様が溜め込んでいる鬱憤もまとめてな。: Diana, include all the frustrations you've been holding in, as well.
m940012.ディアナ様の欲望って、\n帝国のことだけではないですからね。:
Diana-sama's desires
are not just about the Empire, you know.
m940012.ディアナ様？\nもしかして、帝都の視察ですか？: Diana? Are you here on an inspection of the Imperial Capital?
m940012.ドッペルゲンガーのように、私に化けた存在でもない。\n何者ですか、あなたは。:
You are no doppelganger, no entity wearing my face.
Who… or what are you?
m940012.フッ……そうだな。\nならば、ためらう必要はないか。: Hmph... I suppose that's right. Then there's no need to hesitate.
m940012.フッ……もしそうなっても、\n今の白の帝国は安泰だろう。:
Hmph... Even if that were to happen,
the White Empire would remain secure.
m940012.マルゴット、場を和ます必要はありません。: Margot, there is no need to lighten the mood.
m940012.一度影響を受ければ、\n勝手に消えることはないと、そう言いたいのか？:
You're saying that once it takes hold,
it won't simply fade away on its own?
m940012.一箇所にとどまると、君を中心に\nタルタロスの呪いが広がってしまう。\nだから一:
If you stay in one place, the Curse of Tartarus
will spread out from you. So we need to keep you moving.
m940012.下手をすると、陛下の首が飛びますよ。\n過去の私の願望も含まれているなら、ですが:
If we're not careful, Your Majesty's head might roll off.
Especially if my own past wishes are included in the list.
m940012.中々に腕利きの兵でして。\n最近は警備にも同行してもらっているんです。: She's a remarkably skilled soldier. I've been having her join me on security patrols lately.
m940012.今や珍しくもないことです。\n――何者ですか！ 姿を見せなさい！: It's hardly a novelty anymore. —Who are you? Show yourself!
m940012.似た境遇の者がいたのが幸いだったね。\nそれにしても……はぁ、困った父親だなぁ。:
It was fortunate that there was someone with a similar background.
And yet… sigh, what a troublesome father.
m940012.何より、北の街道でも起きているのでしょう？\nそれってつまり――: Above all, it's happening on the northern road too, isn't it? Which means—
m940012.何事もなければいいけどねぇ……。\n……ん？ 何か、足音ずしんずしんしてない？:
I hope nothing's happened, though...
...Hm? Do you hear that? Sounds like heavy footsteps.
m940012.何者って、この村の住人だけど……。\nほら、うちの納屋くらいなら貸してあげるから:
Who? I'm just a villager here…
Look, I can lend you my barn if you want!
m940012.俺がまだ、通っていない場所にも、ということか。: So it's spreading to places I haven't even visited yet.
m940012.俺の周りにも、影が生まれた。\n泥のようなものが湧き、\nやがて俺の姿をした怪物:
Shadows have been born around me as well.

Something like mud welled up,

and eventually, a monster in my likeness appeared.
m940012.俺の呪いに、心当たりがあると言ったな。: You said you have a hunch about my curse.
m940012.借り物の玉座では、できないこともありますので。\nいかがです？ 私の国は。:
There are things one cannot do from a borrowed throne.
Well then? What do you think of my country?
m940012.先に確認しておくが、その黒いものとは何だ？\n黒い泥のようなものか？:
Before we proceed, what is that black substance?
Is it something like black mud?
m940012.処刑せず、転生すれば責め苦が終わるようにした辺り、\nディアスも昔のイクセリスの:
The fact that he chose reincarnation over execution,
hoping the torment would end,
suggests Zeus really liked the old Ixeris, I think.
m940012.前の私は、ディアスの妻を奪おうとした。\n……そう、覚えてるの。:
My past self tried to steal Dias's wife.

...Yes, I remember that.
m940012.力による闘争に翻弄される無力な民、\n平和を望みながらも戦わねば生きていけない者:
The powerless people tossed about by the struggle for power,
those who yearn for peace yet must fight to survive,
those who have lost their homes and weep in despair…
m940012.北の街道っす！ ここからまっすぐっすよ！: ???: The northern highway! It's straight ahead from here!
m940012.厄介ですね……。\nディアナ様を完全複製した、ということですよね？\n記憶も、考:
This is troublesome...
So, you're saying she's a perfect replica of Diana?
Her memories, her thoughts, everything—
m940012.口説こうとしたのは、偽物だった。\nディアスの奥方にしか見えない偽物がいたの。:
The one I tried to seduce was an imitation.

There was a fake that only looked like Dias's wife.
m940012.周囲に獣が残っていないか確かめろ。\n負傷者がいれば……王国に任せられるか？:
Check if any beasts remain in the area.
If there are any wounded… can we leave them to the Kingdom?
m940012.命……？\nただの魔力の塊じゃないってこと？:
Life...?

So it's not just a lump of mana?
m940012.問題は――旅立ちの前に、\n俺の近くにいた者たちか。:
The problem is... the people who were near me
before I left.
m940012.大丈夫だよ。\nもう、彼がすぐそこまで来てるから。:
He'll be fine.
He's already almost here.
m940012.女皇、ですか。\nずいぶんと出世なさいましたね。:
Her Imperial Majesty, is it.
You've certainly risen in the world.
m940012.安泰じゃないと思いますが……。\nおっと、内政干渉は置いといてですね、\nレオナ:
I wouldn't say it's all that secure, though...
Oh, right, let's not get into internal politics.
Leona, are you injured from the fight earlier?
m940012.巨人族の方……？\n落ち着いてください。何があったのですか？:
A member of the Giant race...?
Please calm down. What happened?
m940012.己の生命と引き換えに、\n勝とうが負けようが、民の安全を確約させる手法だ。: A method to guarantee the safety of the people, whether we win or lose, at the cost of one's own life.
m940012.帝都そっくりの都が、できちゃってるんすよー！！: A capital city that looks exactly like the Imperial Capital has just popped up!!
m940012.幻術……いえ、以前も出現した、\nタルタロスの魔力による偽物……？: An illusion... No, a fake created by Tartarus's mana...?
m940012.形を取っただけのものも、あると思う。\nでも、あの時のディアスの奥方は、本物だっ:
I think some are just given form.

But Dias's wife at that time was real.

Not an illusion...
m940012.影とオリジナルで仲良く王国旅行か？\n気楽なものだな、まったく。:
A friendly kingdom trip, shadow and original?
How carefree of you, truly.
m940012.影のディアナの正体は、\n魔力によって生まれた生命体、か……。:
So the true identity of Shadow Diana is
a lifeform born from magic power...
m940012.彼らを見捨ててはおけない、\nそのために皇帝に剣すら向けた、あなたの影です。:
I am the shadow of the one who could not abandon them,
the one who raised her sword even against the Emperor for their sake.
m940012.我らが家族のため、友のため。\n――そして女皇陛下と参謀殿のため！\n我ら必ず、:
For our families, for our friends.
――And for Your Imperial Majesty and the Strategist!
We swear that we will definitely survive!
m940012.我らを置いて、おふたりだけで白の帝国と戦われると？\nその命令には、従えませぬな:
You would leave us and fight the White Empire alone?
I cannot follow such an order.
m940012.手を貸すよ。\nタルタロスのことは詳しくないけど、\n影を生み出す魔法は見たこと:
I'll help.
I don't know much about Tantalos, but
I've seen magic that creates shadows before.
m940012.承知しました。\n……女皇陛下は、どうなさるので？:
Understood.
…What will Her Imperial Majesty do?
m940012.承知しました。\n癒し手も連れてきていますので、おまかせを。:
Understood.
I've brought a healer with me, so leave it to us.
m940012.承知の上だ。\n力を借りねば、望むことさえ許されぬのならな。:
I am aware.
If I cannot borrow power, I will not even be permitted to wish for what I want.
m940012.故郷に住み続けたければ、帝国に従え。\nそれを拒めば、土地を捨てろと？\n我らは:
If you wish to remain in your homeland, submit to the Empire.
If you refuse, then abandon your land?
We choose neither!
m940012.故郷を捨てろとも、俺を慕えとも言わん。\nただ、自治を勝ち取った都市国家であり続:
I am not asking you to abandon your homeland, nor to revere me.
Simply continue to exist as a city-state that has won its autonomy.
There will likely be matters where we can cooperate.
m940012.次の皇帝が、民を見捨てる者だったら。\nその次が、また闘争を望む者だったら。\n:
What if the next Emperor abandons the people?
What if the one after that desires conflict?
You must have had those concerns as well.
m940012.民のためにも、罪人たる私が、\nここに残るわけには参りません。:
For the sake of the people, I, a criminal,
cannot stay here.
m940012.民を守りたいっていう、強い願い。\nその願いを核に生まれた新たな生命体なのよ。:
It's a strong wish to protect the people.
A new lifeform born with that wish as its core.
m940012.決して、死なせはしない。: I will absolutely not let you die.
m940012.無人の都じゃなさそうですね。\nあちらの家にも、こっちにも、ずいぶん大勢の人が。:
It doesn't seem to be an abandoned city.
There are quite a few people in the houses over there and here.
And I've never seen any of them in the Imperial Capital.
m940012.無罪放免として、\nこのまま都市国家の長に据えても良いのですが――:
We could declare them innocent and
install them as the leader of this city-state, but—
m940012.然り。タルタロスの奥底にて、神は待っておられる。\nその器が、完成する時を。:
Indeed. Deep within Tantalos, the god awaits.
For the moment that vessel is complete.
m940012.焼き続けるだけじゃなくて、\nまさかタルタロスに幽閉していたなんて……。\n身内:
Not only did he keep burning him,
but he actually imprisoned him in Tartarus…
That's pretty harsh, even for a family matter…
m940012.熱い……あの炎が、また……。\nいやっ、もうあの場所には、戻りたくないの！:
It's hot… That flame, again…
No… I don't want to go back to that place!
m940012.父が、それを見逃すはずはない。\nとはいえ、たぶん本気で\n罰したかったという感:
My father wouldn't have let that slide.

Still, I doubt he truly wanted to punish you.
m940012.獣が暴れて、里の連中も手一杯で……。\n道にも、変な黒いのが湧くし……。\nあー:
???: The beasts have gone berserk, and the villagers are stretched thin...
Weird black stuff is bubbling up on the road, too...
Ah, I'm going crazy, where do I even start?!
m940012.王子、手を貸せ。\nこのふたりを止め、魔力の流入を断つ。:
Prince, lend me a hand.
Stop the two of them and cut off the inflow of magic power.
m940012.生まれたばかりなんでしょう？\n自分が誰かなんて、これから生きて決めればいい。\:
You were just born, weren't you?
You can decide who you are as you live your life.
There's no need to end it all right now!
m940012.白の帝国としても、\nここまでの国力を持つ都市国家を相手に、\n戦争をしたいとは: Even the White Empire wouldn't want to wage war against a city-state with this much national power, would they?
m940012.皇帝陛下不在の間だけとはいえ、\n帝国の運営の大部分を任せられているのですよね。: Even if it's only while His Majesty is away, you're entrusted with most of the Empire's operations. You must be exhausted, Diana.
m940012.私、どうしちゃったんだろ……。\nタルタロスのことも、自分が亜神だったことも、\:
I... what's wrong with me...?

I had no idea about Tartarus, or that I was a demigod...

Not until just a moment ago...
m940012.私が偽物かどうかは、剣を交えれば分かることでしょう。: ???：You'll find out if I'm the real one once we cross swords.
m940012.私が知ってるものと、似てるよ。\nでも、どうして人間に、こんな酷い呪いを……。:
It resembles what I know.
But why would such a cruel curse be placed on a human…
m940012.私だって、自分が誰なのか、よく分からない。\n村で暮らしてた私と、タルタロスにい:
I don't really know who I am, either.
The me who lived in the village, and the me who was in Tantalos.
Being told suddenly that both of them are me…….
m940012.私の欲望から生まれたのなら、\nそう簡単に生命を捨ててくれるな。\n成し遂げたい:
If you were born from my desires,
don't you dare throw away your life so easily.
You must have more than a few desires left to fulfill.
m940012.私の記憶――正確には、\nオリジナルの記憶の中に、答えがありましたから。: The answer was in my memories—more precisely, in the memories of the original.
m940012.私の願いから生まれたのなら、分かるだろう。\nこの国にいる者たちを、戦に巻き込ん:
If you were born from my wish, you should understand.
What do you intend to do, dragging the people of this country into war?
m940012.私の願望を投影した鏡像、だったんだと思う。\nそんなことにも気づかず、目の前の罠:
I think it was a mirror image of my own desires.

I didn't even realize it and fell right into the trap.
m940012.私は、ここに。\nあなたも、皆を頼みますよ。:
I will stay here.
Please, entrust everyone to you.
m940012.私も同じだから、気持ちは、わかるよ……？\nきっと不安だろうけど、ここにいる人た:
I went through the same thing, so I know how you feel...?

You're probably anxious, but everyone here is

a bit odd, but they're all very kind...
m940012.私を……捕まえるんじゃ、ないの？\nあなたは……亜神ディアスの、血縁者、よね？:
Aren't you going to… capture me?
You're… a relative of the Demigod Zeus, right?
m940012.落ち着いて話せる場所を借りましょう。\n王子、陛下、こちらへ。:
Let us find a place where we can speak calmly.
Prince, Your Majesty, this way.
m940012.褒めていません。\n白の帝国が改革の途上にある、\nこのタイミングを狙った妙手で:
I'm not praising you.
Though it was a clever move, striking while the White Empire is in the midst of reform.
m940012.見事……実に、見事。\n神の試練を、またひとつ越えられたか……。:
Magnificent…… truly, magnificent.
You have overcome one more of the god's trials……
m940012.覚えてるよ。\n亜神ディアスの妻に手を出そうとして、\n永遠の炎に焼かれ続けるこ:
I remember.
The demigod who tried to lay a hand on Zeus's wife
and was condemned to burn in eternal flames.
m940012.話はあとだ。\nまずはこいつらを蹴散らし、\n影のディアナの本拠を目指すぞ。:
We'll finish this talk later.
First, let's crush these and head for Shadow Diana's base.
m940012.責め苦が終わったらまた来るがいい、\nって言ってるようなものだし。: It's like saying, "Come back once the torment is over."
m940012.逃げ遅れた人、たぶん全員助けられたっす！\nありがとうっすー！:
???: I think we managed to rescue everyone who was left behind!
Thank you so much!
m940012.遅かったか……。\n王子、獣を迎えうつぞ。:
We're too late...
Prince, prepare to face the beasts.
m940012.過去の白の帝国であれば、\n不可能だったことでしょう。: Had this been the White Empire of the past, it would have been impossible.
m940012.間違っても、討ち死にの覚悟は、\nなどと言うんじゃないぞ。: Don't you dare say you're prepared to die in battle.
m940012.陛下はこのあとは……。: What will Your Majesty do next?
m940012.陛下！ 前方にうごめく泥のようなものと、\n獣型の魔物らしきものが！:
Your Majesty! There are things that look like writhing mud ahead,
and what appear to be beast-type monsters!
m940012.頼む。\n戻るにしても、距離を取るにしても、\n向こうの状況を知らねばならん。:
I count on you.
Whether we return or keep our distance,
we need to know the situation on their end.
m940012.顔を見た途端、それか。\n互いに、歓迎できる相手ではないらしい。:
The moment you saw my face, you knew.
It seems we are not ones who can welcome each other.
m940012.願いから生まれた純粋な生命体。\nそしておそらくは、生まれたばかり。\nこれは…:
A pure lifeform born from a wish.
And likely, it was just born.
This is... going to be a problem.
m940012.願いを鋳型にして、命を生む。\nその呪いには、そんな力があるんだと思う。\n私が:
Using wishes as a mold to create life.

I think that's the power of that curse.

It feels similar to the magic Dias placed on me.
m940012.魔力通信が届かないのも、\nそれが原因と見て間違いなさそうですね。: It seems safe to assume that's why the mana communications aren't getting through.
m940012.黙れ、偽りの皇帝！ 武器持つは我らの意思！\n家族を連れて、どこへ行けばよいかも:
Silence, False Emperor! Bearing arms is our own will!
When we did not know where to go with our families,
it was Her Imperial Majesty who told us we could live here!
m940012.（えっ、せっかくならご厚意に甘えてもいいのでは？）: (Huh? Shouldn't we just accept the kind offer?)
m940012.（おかげで、ディアスの妻の幻は、\nとんでもない存在になったりしてたけど……。\:
(Thanks to that, the illusion of Dias's wife
ended up becoming quite a formidable existence...
I don't need to mention that part, do I?)
m940012.（この子もここの住人なら帝国臣民。\n陛下も民に呪いの影響を与えたくはないでしょ:
(If this girl is a resident here, she's an Imperial subject.
His Majesty wouldn't want the curse affecting the people, would he?)
m940012.（確かに変わり者が多いですねぇ）: (They are certainly a lot of eccentrics)
m940012.（自分そっくりだけど違う存在を、\n素直に褒めたくないんでしょうね……）: (She doesn't want to praise an existence that looks just like her, but isn't…)
m940012.（言ってやるな。\n私やお前だって、同じ状況に\nなったら恨み言のひとつも言いた:
(Don't say that.
If I or you were in the same situation,
we'd have plenty of complaints to make.)
